function setNight(v,now){NGT.tgt=v?1:0;if(now){NGT.cur=NGT.tgt;NGT.ap=-1;}}
function applyNight(dt){const N_=NGT;if(Math.abs(N_.cur-N_.tgt)<.0005&&N_.ap===N_.cur)return;N_.cur+=(N_.tgt-N_.cur)*Math.min(1,dt*1.6);if(Math.abs(N_.cur-N_.tgt)<.002)N_.cur=N_.tgt;N_.ap=N_.cur;const t=N_.cur,D=N_.D,Q=N_.N;
  hemiL.color.copy(D.h[0]).lerp(Q.h[0],t);hemiL.groundColor.copy(D.h[1]).lerp(Q.h[1],t);hemiL.intensity=lerp(D.h[2],Q.h[2],t);ambL.color.copy(D.a[0]).lerp(Q.a[0],t);ambL.intensity=lerp(D.a[1],Q.a[1],t);
  sun.color.copy(D.s[0]).lerp(Q.s[0],t);sun.intensity=lerp(D.s[1],Q.s[1],t);scene.fog.color.copy(D.f[0]).lerp(Q.f[0],t);scene.fog.density=lerp(D.f[1],Q.f[1],t);skyMat.uniforms.night.value=t;
  for(const p of N_.pools){p.visible=t>.02;p.material.opacity=p.userData.op*t;}}

function facade(kind){
  const W=256,H=256,cols=4,rows=4,cw=W/cols,rh=H/rows;const lit=[],p=kind==='glass'?.4:kind==='hala'?.1:.3;const stripe=pick(['#e9a23b','#d9534f','#3b8fd9','#4caf50','#f06292','#8e6ac8']);
  const map=ctex(W,H,(x)=>{x.fillStyle='#fff';x.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    for(let r=0;r<rows;r++)for(let c=0;c<cols;c++){const X=c*cw,Y=r*rh;const wg=x.createLinearGradient(0,Y,0,Y+rh);wg.addColorStop(0,'#5a7aa8');wg.addColorStop(1,'#26344f');
      if(kind==='glass'){x.fillStyle='#c9c9d6';x.fillRect(X,Y+rh-6,cw,6);x.fillStyle=wg;x.fillRect(X+4,Y+5,cw-8,rh-14);}
      else if(kind==='plyta'){x.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.18)';x.lineWidth=2;x.strokeRect(X,Y,cw,rh);if(c===1){x.fillStyle=stripe;x.fillRect(X+2,Y+2,cw-4,rh-4);}
        x.fillStyle='#f4f4f4';x.fillRect(X+12,Y+12,cw-24,rh-30);x.fillStyle=wg;x.fillRect(X+15,Y+15,cw-30,rh-36);x.fillStyle='#f4f4f4';x.fillRect(X+31,Y+15,2,rh-36);
        if(c%2===0){x.fillStyle='rgba(60,60,70,.85)';x.fillRect(X+6,Y+rh-22,cw-12,16);x.fillStyle=stripe;x.fillRect(X+6,Y+rh-22,cw-12,4);}}
      else if(kind==='kam'){x.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.1)';x.fillRect(X,Y+rh-4,cw,4);x.fillStyle='#fffaf0';x.fillRect(X+16,Y+8,cw-32,rh-22);x.fillRect(X+12,Y+5,cw-24,5);x.fillStyle=wg;x.fillRect(X+20,Y+13,cw-40,rh-31);x.fillStyle='#fffaf0';x.fillRect(X+31,Y+13,2,rh-31);x.fillRect(X+20,Y+30,cw-40,2);}
      else if(kind==='hala'){x.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.07)';for(let i=0;i<8;i++)x.fillRect(X,Y+i*8,cw,2);if(r===0){x.fillStyle=wg;x.fillRect(X+8,Y+12,cw-16,18);}}
      else{x.fillStyle='#fff';x.fillRect(X+14,Y+14,cw-28,rh-30);x.fillStyle=wg;x.fillRect(X+18,Y+18,cw-36,rh-38);x.fillStyle='#fff';x.fillRect(X+31,Y+18,2,rh-38);x.fillStyle='#6a4a3a';x.fillRect(X+8,Y+14,6,rh-30);x.fillRect(X+cw-14,Y+14,6,rh-30);}
      lit.push(RNG()<p&&!(kind==='hala'&&r>0)?pick(['#ffd08a','#ffe7b8','#ffc27a','#fff1c9','#ffd9a8']):null);}});
  const em=ctex(W,H,(x)=>{x.fillStyle='#000';x.fillRect(0,0,W,H);let i=0;for(let r=0;r<rows;r++)for(let c=0;c<cols;c++){const l=lit[i++];if(!l)continue;const X=c*cw,Y=r*rh;x.fillStyle=l;x.globalAlpha=rand(.5,1);
      if(kind==='glass')x.fillRect(X+4,Y+5,cw-8,rh-14);else if(kind==='plyta')x.fillRect(X+15,Y+15,cw-30,rh-36);else if(kind==='kam')x.fillRect(X+20,Y+13,cw-40,rh-31);else if(kind==='hala')x.fillRect(X+8,Y+12,cw-16,18);else x.fillRect(X+18,Y+18,cw-36,rh-38);}x.globalAlpha=1;});
  return {map,em};
}

// (stara wersja, nieużywana) Baron Arena: futurystyczna „korona” – pylony, świetlne aureole, szklane zadaszenie, telebim
function arenaFuture(b){const cx=b.cx,cz=b.cz,hx=(b.x1-b.x0)/2,hz=(b.z1-b.z0)/2,pt=b.pitch,Y=CURB;
  const metal=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:col('#14141c'),roughness:.18,metalness:.85,envMapIntensity:1.6}),gold=neonMat('#ffcc33',3.2),cyan=neonMat('#33e6ff',2.6),white=neonMat('#fff6e0',4);
  const M=[],G=[],C=[],Wh=[];const box=(arr,w,h,d,x,y,z,ry)=>{const g=new THREE.BoxGeometry(w,h,d);if(ry)g.rotateY(ry);g.translate(x,y,z);arr.push(g);};
  // 4 pylony w narożnikach
  const PY=[[-1,-1],[1,-1],[-1,1],[1,1]],ph=21;for(const [sx,sz] of PY){const x=cx+sx*(hx-1.4),z=cz+sz*(hz-1.4);const g=new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.45,1.1,ph,4,1);g.rotateY(Math.PI/4);g.translate(x,Y+ph/2,z);M.push(g);
    box(C,.12,ph-3,.12,x-sx*.62,Y+ph/2,z-sz*.62);const t=new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(.8,0);t.translate(x,Y+ph+.6,z);Wh.push(t);}
  // dwie świetlne aureole nad stadionem
  const halo=(r,tube,y,arr,sy)=>{const g=new THREE.TorusGeometry(1,tube,6,72);g.rotateX(Math.PI/2);g.scale(hx-1.6,1,hz-1.6);g.translate(cx,y,cz);arr.push(g);};
  halo(1,.03,Y+18.6,G);halo(1,.022,Y+17.2,C);{const g=new THREE.TorusGeometry(1,.05,6,72);g.rotateX(Math.PI/2);g.scale(hx-1.6,1,hz-1.6);g.translate(cx,Y+18,cz);M.push(g);}
  // liny od pylonów do środka (podwieszony telebim)
  for(const [sx,sz] of PY){const x=cx+sx*(hx-1.4),z=cz+sz*(hz-1.4),tx=cx+sx*3.4,tz=cz+sz*2.2,ty=Y+15.8,dx=tx-x,dy=ty-(Y+ph-1),dz=tz-z,L=Math.hypot(dx,dy,dz);const g=new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.05,.05,L,5);g.translate(0,L/2,0);
    const q=new THREE.Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(new V3(0,1,0),new V3(dx,dy,dz).normalize());g.applyMatrix4(new THREE.Matrix4().makeRotationFromQuaternion(q));g.translate(x,Y+ph-1,z);M.push(g);}
  // kostka-telebim nad środkiem boiska
  {box(M,7.6,3.6,5.2,cx,Y+15.2,cz);const tex=ctex(512,256,x=>{const g=x.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,256);g.addColorStop(0,'#1a0f2e');g.addColorStop(1,'#05050a');x.fillStyle=g;x.fillRect(0,0,512,256);x.fillStyle='#ffcc33';x.font='900 92px Anton,Impact';x.textAlign='center';x.textBaseline='middle';x.fillText('BARON',256,92);x.fillStyle='#33e6ff';x.font='900 70px Anton,Impact';x.fillText('ARENA',256,182);x.fillStyle='#ffcc33';x.fillRect(40,236,432,6);});
    const sm=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map:tex,color:hdr('#ffffff',1.5)});for(const [w,ry,ox,oz] of[[7.4,0,0,2.62],[7.4,Math.PI,0,-2.62],[5,Math.PI/2,3.82,0],[5,-Math.PI/2,-3.82,0]]){const p=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w,3.3),sm);p.position.set(cx+ox,Y+15.2,cz+oz);p.rotation.y=ry;scene.add(p);}
    box(G,7.8,.12,5.4,cx,Y+13.35,cz);box(G,7.8,.12,5.4,cx,Y+17.05,cz);}
  // pionowe lamele „korony” nad trybunami (bez kolizji – sama dekoracja)
  // szklana elewacja z liniami LED zamiast czarnych ścian trybun + skrzydła dachu
  const fac=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:col('#16233d'),roughness:.08,metalness:.9,envMapIntensity:2,emissive:col('#0a1830'),emissiveIntensity:.6}),FA=[],WG=[];const L=b.z1-b.z0-.6;

  {const me=new THREE.Mesh(MG(FA),fac);scene.add(me);const wm=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:col('#9fd8ff'),roughness:.05,metalness:.7,transparent:true,opacity:.42,envMapIntensity:1.8,depthWrite:false});const we=new THREE.Mesh(MG(WG),wm);scene.add(we);}

  const add=(arr,m,sh)=>{if(!arr.length)return;const me=new THREE.Mesh(MG(arr),m);me.castShadow=!!sh;me.receiveShadow=false;scene.add(me);return me;};
  add(M,metal,true);add(G,gold);add(C,cyan);add(Wh,white);
  // pulsujące aureole
  const hm=add([(()=>{const g=new THREE.TorusGeometry(1,.012,4,72);g.rotateX(Math.PI/2);g.scale(hx+1.2,1,hz+1.2);g.translate(cx,Y+.08,cz);return g;})()],neonMat('#a66bff',2.2));
  for(const [sx,sz] of PY){const x=cx+sx*(hx-1.4),z=cz+sz*(hz-1.4),tx=cx+sx*4,tz=cz+sz*5,dx=tx-x,dz=tz-z,dy=-(ph-1),L=Math.hypot(dx,dy,dz);const g=new THREE.ConeGeometry(4.2,L,20,1,true);g.translate(0,-L/2,0);const m=new THREE.Mesh(g,new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:hdr('#fff3d6',1),transparent:true,opacity:.07,blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending,depthWrite:false,side:THREE.DoubleSide}));m.position.set(x,Y+ph-.5,z);m.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new V3(0,-1,0),new V3(dx,dy,dz).normalize());scene.add(m);}
  b.arenaFx={hm};}

const _near=[];
function pushOutCircle(p,r){
  nearStatics(p.x,p.z,_near);let hit=null;
  for(const c of _near){if(p.x<c.minX-r||p.x>c.maxX+r||p.z<c.minZ-r||p.z>c.maxZ+r)continue;if(p.y!=null&&p.y>c.maxY-.02)continue;
    const cx=clamp(p.x,c.minX,c.maxX),cz=clamp(p.z,c.minZ,c.maxZ);const dx=p.x-cx,dz=p.z-cz,d=Math.hypot(dx,dz);
    if(d<r){if(d<1e-4){const l=p.x-c.minX,rr=c.maxX-p.x,t=p.z-c.minZ,bb=c.maxZ-p.z,mn=Math.min(l,rr,t,bb);
        if(mn===l){p.x=c.minX-r;hit=[-1,0];}else if(mn===rr){p.x=c.maxX+r;hit=[1,0];}else if(mn===t){p.z=c.minZ-r;hit=[0,-1];}else{p.z=c.maxZ+r;hit=[0,1];}}
      else{p.x=cx+dx/d*r;p.z=cz+dz/d*r;hit=[dx/d,dz/d];}}}
  if(p.x<BMIN+r){p.x=BMIN+r;hit=[1,0];}if(p.x>BMAX-r){p.x=BMAX-r;hit=[-1,0];}if(p.z<BMIN+r){p.z=BMIN+r;hit=[0,1];}if(p.z>BMAX-r){p.z=BMAX-r;hit=[0,-1];}
  return hit;
}

      x.globalCompositeOperation='destination-out';x.beginPath();x.ellipse(64,98,15,6.5,0,0,TAU);x.fill();x.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';x.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.07)';x.lineWidth=1;for(let q=0;q<60;q++){const sx=4+Math.random()*120,sy=86+Math.random()*40;x.beginPath();x.moveTo(sx,sy);x.lineTo(sx+(Math.random()-.5)*3,sy+6);x.stroke();}x.restore();}
    if(f.blink){x.strokeStyle='rgba(30,15,10,.85)';x.lineWidth=3;x.lineCap='round';for(const ex of[44,84]){x.beginPath();x.ellipse(ex,57,10,4,0,Math.PI*.1,Math.PI*.9);x.stroke();}}else for(const ex of[44,84]){x.fillStyle='#fff';x.beginPath();x.ellipse(ex,58,11,8.5,0,0,TAU);x.fill();x.fillStyle=['#5a3a1a','#2a6ab0','#3a8a4a','#3a3a3a'][f.eye||0];x.beginPath();x.arc(ex,59,5.6,0,TAU);x.fill();x.fillStyle='#111';x.beginPath();x.arc(ex,59,2.8,0,TAU);x.fill();x.fillStyle='#fff';x.beginPath();x.arc(ex+2,57,1.5,0,TAU);x.fill();

function makeHuman(o){

function killHuman(h){scene.remove(h.root);h.root.traverse(m=>{if(m.geometry&&m.geometry!==faceGeo)m.geometry.dispose();});if(h.shadow)scene.remove(h.shadow);}
function animHuman(h,dt,speed,o){
  o=o||{};h.t+=dt;const run=clamp(speed/7.5,0,1),walk=speed>.25;
  h.ph+=dt*(walk?(4.2+speed*1.15):0);const s=Math.sin(h.ph),c=Math.cos(h.ph);
  let A=walk?(.3+.75*run):0;
  let tl=-s*A,tr=s*A,kl=walk?Math.max(0,c)*(.5+1.3*run)+.1:.05,kr=walk?Math.max(0,-c)*(.5+1.3*run)+.1:.05;
  let al=s*A*.85,ar=-s*A*.85,el=-.25-run*.95,er=-.25-run*.95,alz=.07,arz=-.07,lean=walk?.06+run*.28:.02+Math.sin(h.t*2)*.015;
  let hy=.98-run*.05+(walk?Math.abs(s)*.06*(.4+run):0);
  if(o.air){tl=-.9;kl=1.3;tr=.25;kr=.7;al=-2.2;ar=-1.2;el=er=-.4;lean=.1;}
  if(o.hold){al=.15;alz=.38;el=-1.25;}
  if(o.charge>0){const q=o.charge;tr=.35+.75*q;kr=1.35*q;al=-.5*q;alz=.7*q;arz=-.4*q;lean=.15+.1*q;}
  if(o.kick>0){const k=1-o.kick/.32;const e=Math.sin(Math.min(1,k*1.3)*Math.PI*.5);tr=lerp(1.1,-1.55,e);kr=lerp(1.3,.05,Math.min(1,k*2));al=-.4;alz=.8;lean=.25;if(k>.75){tr=lerp(-1.55,-.3,(k-.75)*4);}}
  if(o.jug>0){const j=Math.sin((1-o.jug/.25)*Math.PI);tr=-.95*j;kr=1.1*j;}
  if(o.slide){tl=-1.45;kl=.05;tr=-.5;kr=1.5;al=.9;ar=.5;el=er=-.3;lean=-.35;hy=.98;}
  if(o.card){ar=-3;er=0;arz=0;}
  if(o.blow){ar=-1.25;er=-1.05;arz=.32;al=-1.15;el=-1.25;alz=-.32;lean=-.12;}
  if(o.carry){ar=-.5;er=-1.1;}
  if(o.celebrate){al=ar=-2.9+Math.sin(h.t*14)*.15;el=er=0;hy=.98+Math.abs(Math.sin(h.t*7))*.25;}
  if(o.keeperReady){al=-.6;ar=-.6;alz=.5;arz=-.5;el=er=-.9;lean=.25;tl=-.2;tr=-.2;kl=kr=.5;hy=.86;}
  if(o.talk){al=-.5+Math.sin(h.t*3)*.25;el=-1.1;}
  if(o.sit){tl=tr=-1.5;kl=kr=1.5;hy=.55;el=er=-1.2;al=ar=-.5;}
  // płynne przejścia między pozami (bez „przeskoków” przy wślizgu, strzale, zatrzymaniu) + skręt tułowia i oddech
  const k=dt>0?Math.min(1,dt*(o.kick>0?34:22)):1,tw=walk?-s*A*.17:Math.sin(h.t*1.3+h.ph)*.02;if(!walk&&!o.sit&&!o.slide)hy+=Math.sin(h.t*1.9)*.006;
  h.hips.position.y+=(hy-h.hips.position.y)*k;const R=(j,v)=>{j.rotation.x+=(v-j.rotation.x)*k;};R(h.thighL,tl);R(h.thighR,tr);R(h.kneeL,kl);R(h.kneeR,kr);R(h.armL,al);R(h.armR,ar);R(h.elbowL,el);R(h.elbowR,er);R(h.torso,lean);
  h.armL.rotation.z+=(alz-h.armL.rotation.z)*k;h.armR.rotation.z+=(arz-h.armR.rotation.z)*k;h.torso.rotation.y+=(tw-h.torso.rotation.y)*k;if(h.head&&!o.sit)h.head.rotation.y+=(-tw*.7-h.head.rotation.y)*k;
}

function ballTexture(base,patch){
  const W=256,H=128,c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=W;c.height=H;const x=c.getContext('2d');const id=x.createImageData(W,H),d=id.data;
  const phi=(1+Math.sqrt(5))/2,vs=[[0,1,phi],[0,-1,phi],[0,1,-phi],[0,-1,-phi],[1,phi,0],[-1,phi,0],[1,-phi,0],[-1,-phi,0],[phi,0,1],[-phi,0,1],[phi,0,-1],[-phi,0,-1]].map(v=>{const l=Math.hypot(...v);return v.map(a=>a/l);});
  const pb=new THREE.Color(base),pp=new THREE.Color(patch);
  for(let j=0;j<H;j++){const lat=(j/H-.5)*Math.PI;for(let i=0;i<W;i++){const lon=i/W*TAU;const px=Math.cos(lat)*Math.cos(lon),py=Math.sin(lat),pz=Math.cos(lat)*Math.sin(lon);
    let b1=-2,b2=-2;for(const v of vs){const dd=v[0]*px+v[1]*py+v[2]*pz;if(dd>b1){b2=b1;b1=dd;}else if(dd>b2)b2=dd;}
    let cc=b1>.93?pp:pb;const seam=(b1-b2)<.012||(b1>.925&&b1<.932);const k=(j*W+i)*4;const f=seam?.25:1;
    d[k]=cc.r*255*f;d[k+1]=cc.g*255*f;d[k+2]=cc.b*255*f;d[k+3]=255;}}
  x.putImageData(id,0,0);const t=new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);t.encoding=THREE.sRGBEncoding;t.anisotropy=4;return t;
}

const cars=[];// {x,z,h,vel,speed,mode:'traffic'|'parked'|'player', axis,lane,dir,pos,max, mesh}
function newCar(color,kind){const m=makeCarMesh(color||pick(CAR_COLS),kind);const c={x:0,z:0,h:0,vel:new V3(),speed:0,mode:'parked',mesh:m,glow:decal(5,col(pick(NEON)),true,.35),shadow:decal(5.5),honk:0,steer:0,lat:new THREE.Vector2(),wheelRot:0};c.glow.scale.set(3.4,1,6.2);c.shadow.scale.set(3,1,5.6);cars.push(c);return c;}
function trafficPlace(c){if(c.axis==='x'){c.x=c.pos;c.z=c.lane;c.h=c.dir>0?Math.PI/2:-Math.PI/2;}else{c.x=c.lane;c.z=c.pos;c.h=c.dir>0?0:Math.PI;}const dx=c.x-RONDO.x,dz=c.z-RONDO.z,d=Math.hypot(dx,dz);if(d<RONDO.R+5){const want=RONDO.R+Math.max(0,d-RONDO.R)*.0,f=clamp(1-(d-RONDO.R)/5,0,1);const nd=lerp(d,Math.max(d,want),f);const px=c.x,pz=c.z;c.x=RONDO.x+dx/(d||1)*nd;c.z=RONDO.z+dz/(d||1)*nd;if(c._rp){const mx=c.x-c._rp[0],mz=c.z-c._rp[1];if(Math.hypot(mx,mz)>.02)c.h=Math.atan2(mx,mz);}}c._rp=[c.x,c.z];}
function spawnTraffic(c,avoidNear){
  for(let t=0;t<200;t++){const axis=Math.random()<.5?'x':'z',i=randi(0,N),dir=Math.random()<.5?1:-1,lane=(axis==='x'?ZL[i]:XL[i])+dir*3.8*(axis==='x'?1:-1),AX=axis==='x'?XL:ZL,pos=rand(AX[0]+4,AX[N]-4);
    if(cars.some(o=>o!==c&&o.mode==='traffic'&&o.axis===axis&&o.lane===lane&&Math.abs(o.pos-pos)<14))continue;
    const px=axis==='x'?pos:lane,pz=axis==='x'?lane:pos;if(avoidNear&&Math.hypot(px-P.pos.x,pz-P.pos.z)<70)continue;{const sg=segIdx(axis==='x'?XL:ZL,pos);if(sg>=0&&sg<N&&isClosed(axis,i,sg))continue;if(Math.hypot(px-RONDO.x,pz-RONDO.z)<16)continue;}
    Object.assign(c,{mode:'traffic',axis,dir,lane,pos,speed:rand(4,8),max:rand(9,14),turnP:.07,ut:null,arm:null});trafficPlace(c);return true;}return false;
}
function lightState(axis,t){const c=t%18;if(axis==='x')return c<6?'g':c<7.5?'y':'r';return(c>=9&&c<15)?'g':(c>=15&&c<16.5)?'y':'r';}
function placeCarMesh(c,dt){const gy=Math.max(0,groundH(c.x,c.z));c.y=c.y==null?gy:c.y+(gy-c.y)*Math.min(1,(dt||1)*14);c.mesh.g.position.set(c.x,c.y+(c.fallY||0),c.z);c.mesh.g.rotation.y=c.h;if(c.roll!=null)c.mesh.g.rotation.z=c.roll;c.glow.position.set(c.x,.05,c.z);c.glow.rotation.y=c.h;c.shadow.position.set(c.x,.04,c.z);c.shadow.rotation.y=c.h;
  c.wheelRot+=c.speed*dt/.37;for(let i=0;i<4;i++){c.mesh.wheels[i].w.rotation.x=c.wheelRot;if(i<2)c.mesh.wheels[i].piv.rotation.y=c.steer*.5;}}

// ---------- goal ----------
function makeGoal(W,H,D,beamColor){
  const g=new THREE.Group();const pm=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:col('#ffffff'),roughness:.3,emissive:col('#ffffff'),emissiveIntensity:.4});
  const post=new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.08*W/5,.08*W/5,H,10);
  for(const s of[-1,1]){const p=new THREE.Mesh(post,pm);p.position.set(s*W/2,H/2,0);p.castShadow=true;g.add(p);const bp=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.04,.04,Math.hypot(D,H)*.98,6),pm);bp.position.set(s*W/2,H/2,-D/2);bp.rotation.x=Math.atan2(D,H);g.add(bp);}

function placeGoal(G,x,z,nx,nz){
  const y=CURB;
  if(G.hid){G.hid.visible=true;G.hid=null;}for(const b of blocks)if(b.staticGoals&&b.pitch&&x>b.pitch.x0-3&&x<b.pitch.x1+3&&z>b.pitch.z0-4&&z<b.pitch.z1+4){const sg=Math.abs(z-b.pitch.z0)<Math.abs(z-b.pitch.z1)?b.staticGoals[0]:b.staticGoals[1];sg.visible=false;G.hid=sg;break;}
  Object.assign(G,{x,y,z,nx,nz,tx:nz,tz:-nx,prev:null,active:true});G.g.position.set(x,y,z);G.g.rotation.y=Math.atan2(nx,nz);G.g.visible=true;
  const c=[],pr=.1*G.W/5+.04;
  for(const s of[-1,1]){const px=x+G.tx*G.W/2*s,pz=z+G.tz*G.W/2*s;c.push({minX:px-pr,maxX:px+pr,minY:y,maxY:y+G.H,minZ:pz-pr,maxZ:pz+pr,post:1});}
  const hx=Math.abs(G.tx)*G.W/2+pr,hz=Math.abs(G.tz)*G.W/2+pr;c.push({minX:x-hx,maxX:x+hx,minY:y+G.H-pr,maxY:y+G.H+pr,minZ:z-hz,maxZ:z+hz,post:1});
  // back net (soft) as thin box behind
  const bxC=x-nx*G.D,bzC=z-nz*G.D;const bhx=Math.abs(G.tx)*G.W/2+.05+Math.abs(nx)*.05,bhz=Math.abs(G.tz)*G.W/2+.05+Math.abs(nz)*.05;
  c.push({minX:bxC-bhx,maxX:bxC+bhx,minY:y,maxY:y+G.H,minZ:bzC-bhz,maxZ:bzC+bhz,net:1});
  for(const s of[-1,1]){const sx=x+G.tx*G.W/2*s-nx*G.D/2,sz=z+G.tz*G.W/2*s-nz*G.D/2;const shx=Math.abs(nx)*G.D/2+.05,shz=Math.abs(nz)*G.D/2+.05;c.push({minX:sx-shx,maxX:sx+shx,minY:y,maxY:y+G.H,minZ:sz-shz,maxZ:sz+shz,net:1});}
  G.cols=c;G.backGeo.attributes.position.array.set(G.base);G.backGeo.attributes.position.needsUpdate=true;
}

const SP=400,spPos=new Float32Array(SP*3),spCol=new Float32Array(SP*3),spVel=new Float32Array(SP*3),spLife=new Float32Array(SP);let spIdx=0;

function burst(x,y,z,n,speed,colors){const c=new THREE.Color();for(let k=0;k<n;k++){const i=spIdx++%SP;spPos[i*3]=x;spPos[i*3+1]=y;spPos[i*3+2]=z;const a=Math.random()*TAU,u=rand(-.2,1),s=rand(.3,1)*speed;
  spVel[i*3]=Math.cos(a)*Math.sqrt(1-u*u)*s;spVel[i*3+1]=Math.abs(u)*s+speed*.3;spVel[i*3+2]=Math.sin(a)*Math.sqrt(1-u*u)*s;spLife[i]=rand(1,2.4);c.copy(hdr(pick(colors||NEON),3));spCol[i*3]=c.r;spCol[i*3+1]=c.g;spCol[i*3+2]=c.b;}spGeo.attributes.color.needsUpdate=true;}
function updateSparks(dt){for(let i=0;i<SP;i++){if(spLife[i]<=0)continue;spLife[i]-=dt;spVel[i*3+1]-=12*dt;spVel[i*3]*=1-dt*.8;spVel[i*3+2]*=1-dt*.8;spPos[i*3]+=spVel[i*3]*dt;spPos[i*3+1]=Math.max(.05,spPos[i*3+1]+spVel[i*3+1]*dt);spPos[i*3+2]+=spVel[i*3+2]*dt;if(spLife[i]<=0)spPos[i*3+1]=-999;}spGeo.attributes.position.needsUpdate=true;updateWhistleWaves(dt);}

// ---------- physics: sphere vs AABB / car ----------
function sphereBox(b,c,e,cv){
  const p=b.pos,r=b.r;const cx=clamp(p.x,c.minX,c.maxX),cy=clamp(p.y,c.minY,c.maxY),cz=clamp(p.z,c.minZ,c.maxZ);
  let dx=p.x-cx,dy=p.y-cy,dz=p.z-cz;const d2=dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz;if(d2>=r*r)return 0;let nx,ny,nz;const d=Math.sqrt(d2);
  if(d<1e-5){const pens=[[p.x-c.minX,-1,0,0],[c.maxX-p.x,1,0,0],[p.y-c.minY,0,-1,0],[c.maxY-p.y,0,1,0],[p.z-c.minZ,0,0,-1],[c.maxZ-p.z,0,0,1]];let best=pens[0];for(const q of pens)if(q[0]<best[0])best=q;
    nx=best[1];ny=best[2];nz=best[3];p.x+=nx*(best[0]+r);p.y+=ny*(best[0]+r);p.z+=nz*(best[0]+r);}
  else{nx=dx/d;ny=dy/d;nz=dz/d;p.x=cx+nx*r;p.y=cy+ny*r;p.z=cz+nz*r;}
  const rvx=b.vel.x-(cv?cv.x:0),rvy=b.vel.y,rvz=b.vel.z-(cv?cv.z:0);const vn=rvx*nx+rvy*ny+rvz*nz;
  if(vn<0){b.vel.x-=(1+e)*vn*nx;b.vel.y-=(1+e)*vn*ny;b.vel.z-=(1+e)*vn*nz;const t=.12;b.vel.x-=(rvx-vn*nx)*t;b.vel.z-=(rvz-vn*nz)*t;return -vn;}return 0;
}
function sphereCar(b,c,e,boost){
  const sh=Math.sin(c.h),ch=Math.cos(c.h);const dx=b.pos.x-c.x,dz=b.pos.z-c.z;const lf=dx*sh+dz*ch,lr=dx*ch-dz*sh,ly=b.pos.y;
  const cf=clamp(lf,-2.28,2.28),cr=clamp(lr,-1.02,1.02),cy=clamp(ly,.28,lf<0.9&&lf>-1.6?1.5:1.08);
  let nf=lf-cf,nr=lr-cr,ny=ly-cy;const d2=nf*nf+nr*nr+ny*ny;if(d2>=b.r*b.r)return 0;let d=Math.sqrt(d2);if(d<1e-5){ny=1;d=1;nf=nr=0;}
  nf/=d;nr/=d;ny/=d;const nx=nf*sh+nr*ch,nz=nf*ch-nr*sh;
  const wx=c.x+cf*sh+cr*ch,wz=c.z+cf*ch-cr*sh;b.pos.set(wx+nx*b.r,cy+ny*b.r,wz+nz*b.r);
  const rvx=b.vel.x-c.vel.x,rvy=b.vel.y,rvz=b.vel.z-c.vel.z;const vn=rvx*nx+rvy*ny+rvz*nz;
  if(vn<0){const k=(1+e)*vn*(boost||1);b.vel.x-=k*nx;b.vel.y-=k*ny;b.vel.z-=k*nz;if(boost&&boost>1)b.vel.y+=Math.min(6,-vn*.18);return -vn;}return 0;
}
const _ns=[];
function stepBody(b,dt,opts){
  const sp=b.vel.length();const n=clamp(Math.ceil(sp*dt/(b.r*.7)),1,10),h=dt/n;let impact=0,post=0,carHit=0,netHit=0;
  for(let s=0;s<n;s++){
    b.vel.y-=GRAV*h;b.pos.addScaledVector(b.vel,h);
    const gh=groundH(b.pos.x,b.pos.z);
    if(b.pos.y<gh+b.r){if(gh>0&&b.pos.y<gh+b.r-.12&&b.pos.y<gh){/* curb edge */}b.pos.y=gh+b.r;if(b.vel.y<-1.8){impact=Math.max(impact,-b.vel.y);b.vel.y=-b.vel.y*b.e;}else b.vel.y=0;b.onGround=true;}
    nearStatics(b.pos.x,b.pos.z,_ns);
    for(const c of _ns){if(b.pos.x<c.minX-b.r-1||b.pos.x>c.maxX+b.r+1||b.pos.z<c.minZ-b.r-1||b.pos.z>c.maxZ+b.r+1)continue;impact=Math.max(impact,sphereBox(b,c,c.fence?.7:.5));}
    for(const G of GOALS)if(G.g.visible)for(const c of G.cols){const v=sphereBox(b,c,c.net?.05:.6);if(c.net&&v>0){netHit=Math.max(netHit,v);b.vel.multiplyScalar(.35);}else if(v>3)post=Math.max(post,v);}
    for(const c of cars){if(Math.abs(b.pos.x-c.x)>4||Math.abs(b.pos.z-c.z)>4)continue;const v=sphereCar(b,c,.45,c.mode==='player'?1.25:1);if(v>4)carHit=Math.max(carHit,v);}
    if(opts&&opts.extra)opts.extra(b);
    if(b.pos.x<BMIN+b.r){b.pos.x=BMIN+b.r;b.vel.x=Math.abs(b.vel.x)*.6;}if(b.pos.x>BMAX-b.r){b.pos.x=BMAX-b.r;b.vel.x=-Math.abs(b.vel.x)*.6;}
    if(b.pos.z<BMIN+b.r){b.pos.z=BMIN+b.r;b.vel.z=Math.abs(b.vel.z)*.6;}if(b.pos.z>BMAX-b.r){b.pos.z=BMAX-b.r;b.vel.z=-Math.abs(b.vel.z)*.6;}
  }
  const onG=b.pos.y<=groundH(b.pos.x,b.pos.z)+b.r+.02;const f=onG?Math.max(0,1-(b.r>1?.9:1.25)*dt):1-.06*dt;b.vel.x*=f;b.vel.z*=f;
  const hs=Math.hypot(b.vel.x,b.vel.z);if(hs>.02){const ax=new V3(b.vel.z,0,-b.vel.x).normalize();b.mesh.rotateOnWorldAxis(ax,hs*dt/b.r);}
  b.mesh.position.copy(b.pos);const gh=groundH(b.pos.x,b.pos.z);b.shadow.position.set(b.pos.x,gh+.03,b.pos.z);const k=Math.max(.3,1-(b.pos.y-gh)*.06);b.shadow.scale.set(b.r*2.6*k,1,b.r*2.6*k);b.shadow.material.opacity=k;
  return {impact,post,carHit,netHit};
}

function SW(j,k,side,t){const b=blocks[j*N+k],d=1.8;t=t==null?.5:t;if(side==='n')return{x:b.x0+t*(b.x1-b.x0),z:b.z0+d,side};if(side==='s')return{x:b.x0+t*(b.x1-b.x0),z:b.z1-d,side};if(side==='w')return{x:b.x0+d,z:b.z0+t*(b.z1-b.z0),side};return{x:b.x1-d,z:b.z0+t*(b.z1-b.z0),side};}
function curbSpot(pl){const o=3.5;if(pl.side==='e')return{x:pl.x+o,z:pl.z,h:0};if(pl.side==='w')return{x:pl.x-o,z:pl.z,h:Math.PI};if(pl.side==='n')return{x:pl.x,z:pl.z-o,h:Math.PI/2};return{x:pl.x,z:pl.z+o,h:-Math.PI/2};}

// cel ucieczki: daleki punkt miasta, z dala od gracza – auto jedzie przez całe miasto, a nie w kółko wokół kwartału
function fleeDest(c){let best=null,bs=-1e9;for(let t=0;t<24;t++){const x=XL[randi(0,N)],z=ZL[randi(0,N)],d=Math.hypot(x-c.x,z-c.z),dp=Math.hypot(x-P.pos.x,z-P.pos.z);if(d<150)continue;const s=d*.6+dp*.5+rand(0,60);if(s>bs){bs=s;best={x,z};}}return best||{x:XL[randi(0,N)],z:ZL[randi(0,N)]};}
function laneOf(axis,i,dir){return axis==='x'?ZL[i]+dir*3.8:XL[i]-dir*3.8;}
function turnOpts(c,i){const AL=c.axis==='x'?XL:ZL,LL=c.axis==='x'?ZL:XL,li=lineIdx(LL,c.lane),ax2=c.axis==='x'?'z':'x',o=[];const ix=c.axis==='x'?AL[i]:LL[li],iz=c.axis==='x'?LL[li]:AL[i],atR=Math.hypot(ix-RONDO.x,iz-RONDO.z)<3;
  const sg=segIdx(AL,AL[i]+c.dir*6);if(sg>=0&&sg<N&&!isClosed(c.axis,li,sg))o.push({nd:0,vx:c.axis==='x'?c.dir:0,vz:c.axis==='x'?0:c.dir});
  if(!atR)for(const nd of[1,-1]){const seg=nd>0?li:li-1;if(seg<0||seg>=N||isClosed(ax2,i,seg))continue;o.push({nd,vx:ax2==='x'?nd:0,vz:ax2==='x'?0:nd});}return o;}
function doTurn(c,i,nd){const AL=c.axis==='x'?XL:ZL,ax2=c.axis==='x'?'z':'x',lane2=laneOf(ax2,i,nd);const posNew=c.lane;c.axis=ax2;c.dir=nd;c.lane=lane2;c.pos=posNew;c.turnCd=1.0;c.speed*=.75;c.pend=null;}
function fleeTurn(c,prev){if((c.turnCd=(c.turnCd||0)-1/60)>0)return;const AL=c.axis==='x'?XL:ZL;
  if(!c.dest||Math.hypot(c.dest.x-c.x,c.dest.z-c.z)<40)c.dest=fleeDest(c);
  for(let i=0;i<=N;i++){const lA=laneOf(c.axis==='x'?'z':'x',i,1),lB=laneOf(c.axis==='x'?'z':'x',i,-1);const lanes=[[1,lA],[-1,lB]];
    for(const [nd,l2] of lanes){if(!((prev-l2)*(c.pos-l2)<=0))continue;
      if(c.pend&&c.pend.i===i){if(c.pend.nd===nd){doTurn(c,i,nd);return;}continue;}
      if(c.pend&&c.pend.i!==i)c.pend=null;if(c.decided===i+':'+c.axis+c.lane)continue;c.decided=i+':'+c.axis+c.lane;
      const opts=turnOpts(c,i);if(!opts.length)return;const tx=c.dest.x-c.x,tz=c.dest.z-c.z,tl=Math.hypot(tx,tz)||1;let best=null,bs=-1e9;
      for(const o of opts){let s=(o.vx*tx+o.vz*tz)/tl+rand(-.25,.25)*(c.turny==null?.5:c.turny+.2);const px=P.pos.x-c.x,pz=P.pos.z-c.z,pl=Math.hypot(px,pz);if(pl<35&&(o.vx*px+o.vz*pz)/pl>.6)s-=1.2;if(o.nd===0)s+=.12;if(s>bs){bs=s;best=o;}}
      if(!best||best.nd===0)return;if(best.nd===nd){doTurn(c,i,nd);return;}c.pend={i,nd:best.nd};return;}}}
// zwykły ruch: czasem skręca na skrzyżowaniu (płynnie, bez teleportu)
function trafTurnArm(c){c.arm=1;}
function trafTurn(c,prev){const AL=c.axis==='x'?XL:ZL;for(let i=0;i<=N;i++){for(const nd of[1,-1]){const l2=laneOf(c.axis==='x'?'z':'x',i,nd);if(!((prev-l2)*(c.pos-l2)<=0))continue;const o=turnOpts(c,i).filter(q=>q.nd===nd);if(o.length&&Math.random()<.5){doTurn(c,i,nd);c.arm=null;return;}}}}

function steerTo(c,tx,tz,maxS,dt){{const dx=c.x-RONDO.x,dz=c.z-RONDO.z,d=Math.hypot(dx,dz);if(d<RONDO.R+10&&d>1){const vx=tx-c.x,vz=tz-c.z,vl=Math.hypot(vx,vz)||1;const t=clamp(-(dx*vx+dz*vz)/vl,0,vl),qx=c.x+vx/vl*t-RONDO.x,qz=c.z+vz/vl*t-RONDO.z;if(Math.hypot(qx,qz)<RONDO.R-1&&vl>4){const a=Math.atan2(dx,dz)+.75;tx=RONDO.x+Math.sin(a)*RONDO.R;tz=RONDO.z+Math.cos(a)*RONDO.R;}}}
  const ta=Math.atan2(tx-c.x,tz-c.z),dh=angDiff(c.h,ta);
  if(c.rev>0){c.rev-=dt;c.speed=lerp(c.speed,-6,Math.min(1,dt*4));c.h-=Math.sign(dh||1)*1.6*dt;}
  else{const tg=Math.abs(dh)>1?Math.min(maxS,8):maxS;c.speed+=(tg-c.speed)*Math.min(1,dt*1.4);c.h+=clamp(dh,-1,1)*2.4*dt*clamp(c.speed/7,0,1);}
  const fx=Math.sin(c.h),fz=Math.cos(c.h);c.vel.set(fx*c.speed,0,fz*c.speed);c.x+=c.vel.x*dt;c.z+=c.vel.z*dt;let wall=false;
  for(const off of[1.4,-1.4]){const p={x:c.x+fx*off,z:c.z+fz*off},bx=p.x,bz=p.z;if(pushOutCircle(p,1.05)){c.x+=p.x-bx;c.z+=p.z-bz;wall=true;}}
  if(wall)c.speed*=Math.max(0,1-2.5*dt);
  if(Math.abs(c.speed)<2&&c.rev<=0&&maxS>3){c.stuck=(c.stuck||0)+dt;if(c.stuck>.9){c.rev=1.1;c.stuck=0;}}else c.stuck=0;
  for(const o of cars){if(o===c||o===P.car||o.ai)continue;const dx=c.x-o.x,dz=c.z-o.z,dd=Math.hypot(dx,dz);if(dd<3.1&&dd>0){c.x+=dx/dd*(3.1-dd)*.5;c.z+=dz/dd*(3.1-dd)*.5;}}
}
function driveAI(c,dt){const a=c.ai;if(c.spinT>0){c.spinT-=dt;c.h+=dt*9;c.speed=0;c.vel.set(0,0,0);return;}if(a.stop){c.speed*=Math.max(0,1-4*dt);c.vel.set(Math.sin(c.h)*c.speed,0,Math.cos(c.h)*c.speed);c.x+=c.vel.x*dt;c.z+=c.vel.z*dt;return;}
  const p=a.pts[a.i];if(!p){a.done=true;a.stop=true;return;}steerTo(c,p.x,p.z,a.speed,dt);if(Math.hypot(p.x-c.x,p.z-c.z)<6){a.i++;if(a.i>=a.pts.length){if(a.loop)a.i=0;else{a.done=true;a.stop=true;}}}}

// ---------- pedestrians ----------
const peds=[];
const CLOTHES=['#6a5acd','#e0e0e0','#2e8b57','#d2691e','#4682b4','#b03060','#333333','#daa520','#ff8fab','#7fe0c8','#ffd27a','#c0392b','#16a085'];
function pedPath(p){const x0=p.b.x0+1.4,z0=p.b.z0+1.4,x1=p.b.x1-1.4,z1=p.b.z1-1.4,aw=x1-x0,ad=z1-z0,L=2*aw+2*ad;let s=((p.s%L)+L)%L;
  if(s<aw)return [x0+s,z0,1,0];s-=aw;if(s<ad)return [x1,z0+s,0,1];s-=ad;if(s<aw)return [x1-s,z1,-1,0];s-=aw;return [x0,z1-s,0,-1];}
function nearestS(b,x,z){const x0=b.x0+1.4,z0=b.z0+1.4,x1=b.x1-1.4,z1=b.z1-1.4,aw=x1-x0,ad=z1-z0;const c=[[Math.abs(z-z0),clamp(x-x0,0,aw)],[Math.abs(x-x1),aw+clamp(z-z0,0,ad)],[Math.abs(z-z1),aw+ad+clamp(x1-x,0,aw)],[Math.abs(x-x0),2*aw+ad+clamp(z1-z,0,ad)]];c.sort((u,v)=>u[0]-v[0]);return c[0][1];}
const landBlocks=blocks.filter(b=>!b.river);
for(let i=0;i<58;i++){const b=pick(landBlocks);const pants=Math.random()<.65,old=Math.random()<.15;const h=makeHuman({shirt:pick(CLOTHES),shorts:pick(['#333344','#1b2a4a','#5a4a3a','#c8b89a','#2a2a2a','#3a5a8a']),pants,socks:'#ffffff',shoes:pick(['#222222','#ffffff','#8a4a2a']),cap:Math.random()<.18?pick(CLOTHES):null,long:Math.random()<.35,belly:Math.random()<.25,hair:old?'#cccccc':null,build:pick([0,1,1,2]),tall:rand(.93,1.05)});blob(h,1.1);
  peds.push({h,b,s:rand(0,2*(b.x1-b.x0+b.z1-b.z0)-11),dir:Math.random()<.5?1:-1,speed:old?rand(.7,1):rand(1.1,1.7),state:'walk',x:0,z:0,y:CURB,v:new V3(),t:0,flee:0,ang:0});}
function knockPed(p,vx,vy,vz){if(p.state!=='walk')return;if(!ball.hidden&&Math.hypot(ball.pos.x-p.x,ball.pos.z-p.z)<2)ball.hitBack=.7;p.state='air';p.v.set(vx,vy,vz);p.t=0;sfx.ouch();floatText(pick(['Ała!','Ej!!','Moja głowa!','Uważaj!','Straż!!','Auć!','Sędzia!!','Ludzie, co za czasy!','O matko!']),p.x,2.4,p.z,'#ff8080');}
function updatePeds(dt){
  const bs=ball.vel.length();
  for(const p of peds){
    if(p.state==='air'){p.v.y-=GRAV*dt;p.x+=p.v.x*dt;p.z+=p.v.z*dt;p.y+=p.v.y*dt;p.h.root.rotation.x-=dt*7;const gh=Math.max(0,groundH(p.x,p.z));const q={x:p.x,z:p.z};if(pushOutCircle(q,.4)){p.x=q.x;p.z=q.z;p.v.x*=-.3;p.v.z*=-.3;}
      if(p.y<=gh&&p.v.y<0){p.y=gh;p.state='down';p.t=0;p.h.root.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;}
      p.h.root.position.set(p.x,p.y,p.z);p.h.shadow.position.set(p.x,gh+.03,p.z);continue;}
    if(p.state==='down'){p.t+=dt;if(p.t>4){p.state='rise';p.t=0;}continue;}
    if(p.state==='rise'){p.t+=dt;p.h.root.rotation.x=lerp(-Math.PI/2,0,Math.min(1,p.t/.6));if(p.t>.6){p.state='walk';p.h.root.rotation.x=0;const b=blockAt(p.x,p.z);if(b&&!b.river)p.b=b;p.s=nearestS(p.b,p.x,p.z);}continue;}
    let sp=p.speed;if(p.flee>0){p.flee-=dt;sp=p.thief?5.2:4.6;}
    p.s+=p.dir*sp*dt;const [tx,tz,hx,hz]=pedPath(p);p.x=lerp(p.x||tx,tx,Math.min(1,dt*6));p.z=lerp(p.z||tz,tz,Math.min(1,dt*6));p.y=CURB;
    const dP=Math.hypot(p.x-P.pos.x,p.z-P.pos.z),vis=dP<72;p.h.root.visible=p.h.shadow.visible=vis;if(!vis)continue;
    const ta=Math.atan2(hx*p.dir,hz*p.dir);p.ang+=angDiff(p.ang,ta)*Math.min(1,dt*8);
    p.h.root.position.set(p.x,p.y,p.z);p.h.root.rotation.y=p.ang;animHuman(p.h,dt,sp);p.h.shadow.position.set(p.x,p.y+.03,p.z);
    if(!ball.hidden&&bs>7){const dx=ball.pos.x-p.x,dz=ball.pos.z-p.z,d2=dx*dx+dz*dz;
      if(d2<.45&&ball.pos.y<p.y+1.9){knockPed(p,ball.vel.x*.25,4,ball.vel.z*.25);ball.vel.x*=-.3;ball.vel.z*=-.3;if(!mt.on)addHeat(.5);addSup(4);continue;}
      if(d2<16&&p.flee<=0){p.flee=2;if(Math.random()<.4)floatText(pick(['Hej!','Uwaga!','Ej ty!']),p.x,2.4,p.z,'#fff');}}
    if(P.car){const c=P.car,dx=p.x-c.x,dz=p.z-c.z,d=Math.hypot(dx,dz);const cs=Math.hypot(c.vel.x,c.vel.z);
      if(d<1.55&&cs>4){knockPed(p,c.vel.x*.85,4+cs*.12,c.vel.z*.85);addHeat(1);shake=Math.max(shake,.25);sfx.thud();continue;}
      if(d<12&&cs>8&&(c.vel.x*dx+c.vel.z*dz)>0&&p.flee<=0){p.flee=2.2;if(Math.random()<.5)floatText(pick(['AAA!','Wariat!','Ratunku!','Gdzie z tym gruchotem!']),p.x,2.4,p.z,'#ff8080');}}
    else if(!P.stun&&dP<.7&&dP>0){P.pos.x-=(p.x-P.pos.x)/dP*(.7-dP)*.5;P.pos.z-=(p.z-P.pos.z)/dP*(.7-dP)*.5;}
  }
}

const straz=[],pursuit=[],rivals=[];
const W={seen:false,last:new V3(),search:0,visT:0,blkT:8};
function addHeat(v){if(mt.on||noCops||duel||(M&&M.s&&M.s.noHeat))return;const b=Math.floor(heat);heat=Math.min(5.99,heat+v);W.search=0;W.last.copy(P.pos);
  if(Math.floor(heat)>b){$('stars').classList.add('blink');setTimeout(()=>$('stars').classList.remove('blink'),1800);if(b===0){sfx.whistle();feed('🚨 Straż miejska Cię szuka');W.seen=true;}}}
function spawnStrazAt(x,z){const h=makeHuman({shirt:'#1d2b6b',shorts:'#111a3a',pants:true,shoes:'#111111',vest:'#d4ff00',cap:'#111a3a',bald:true,belly:Math.random()<.4,face:{eye:3,brow:1,mouth:4,beard:Math.random()<.5?2:0,glasses:0}});blob(h,1.2);
  const siren=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(.07,8,6),new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:hdr('#2060ff',8)}));siren.position.set(.18,.55,.1);h.torso.add(siren);
  straz.push({h,siren,pos:new V3(x,Math.max(0,groundH(x,z)),z),vel:new V3(),stun:0,wx:x,wz:z,wt:0});}
function spawnStraz(){const fx=-Math.sin(cam.yaw),fz=-Math.cos(cam.yaw),cx=W.seen?P.pos.x:W.last.x,cz=W.seen?P.pos.z:W.last.z;
  for(let t=0;t<60;t++){const a=Math.random()*TAU,r=rand(30,46);const x=cx+Math.cos(a)*r,z=cz+Math.sin(a)*r;
    if(t<40&&(Math.cos(a)*fx+Math.sin(a)*fz)>.3)continue;if(x<BMIN+2||x>BMAX-2||z<BMIN+2||z>BMAX-2||insideBuilding(x,z,1)||groundH(x,z)<0)continue;spawnStrazAt(x,z);return;}}
function removeStraz(s){killHuman(s.h);const i=straz.indexOf(s);if(i>=0)straz.splice(i,1);}
function clearChasers(){straz.slice().forEach(removeStraz);pursuit.slice().forEach(removeCar);heat=0;bustT=0;P.grab=0;W.seen=false;W.search=0;}

  W.visT-=dt;if(W.visT<=0){W.visT=.2;let seen=false;const rng=P.car?44:32;inSmoke=clouds.some(c=>Math.hypot(c.x-P.pos.x,c.z-P.pos.z)<8);
    if(!inSmoke){for(const s of straz){if(s.stun>0)continue;const d=Math.hypot(s.pos.x-P.pos.x,s.pos.z-P.pos.z);if(d<rng&&(d<8||losClear(s.pos.x,s.pos.z,P.pos.x,P.pos.z))){seen=true;break;}}
      if(!seen)for(const c of pursuit){if(c.stun>0)continue;const d=Math.hypot(c.x-P.pos.x,c.z-P.pos.z);if(d<rng+6&&(d<10||losClear(c.x,c.z,P.pos.x,P.pos.z))){seen=true;break;}}}

    let dx=tx-s.pos.x,dz=tz-s.pos.z;const d=Math.hypot(dx,dz)||1;dx/=d;dz/=d;
    s.vel.x+=(dx*sp-s.vel.x)*Math.min(1,dt*5);s.vel.z+=(dz*sp-s.vel.z)*Math.min(1,dt*5);s.pos.x+=s.vel.x*dt;s.pos.z+=s.vel.z*dt;pushOutCircle(s.pos,.4);

    if(P.car){const c=P.car,cd=Math.hypot(s.pos.x-c.x,s.pos.z-c.z),cs=Math.hypot(c.vel.x,c.vel.z);if(cd<1.6&&cs>4){s.stun=4;addHeat(.6);sfx.thud();floatText('BUM!',s.pos.x,2.5,s.pos.z,'#33e6ff');}}

      if(bsp>8&&bd<.6&&ball.pos.y<s.pos.y+1.9){s.stun=3.5;ball.vel.x*=-.3;ball.vel.z*=-.3;ball.vel.y=4;addHeat(.3);addResp(1);addSup(8);sfx.thud();floatText('TRAFIONY!',s.pos.x,2.6,s.pos.z,'#33e6ff');continue;}}
    if(!P.car&&!conf&&dP<1.1&&P.pos.y<s.pos.y+.7&&!dlgOn)grab=true;
  }
  if(grab){P.grab+=dt;prompt('Straż Cię łapie! <kbd>SPACJA</kbd> skok lub <kbd>PPM</kbd> wślizg');if(P.grab>.9&&state==='play'){busted();return;}}else P.grab=Math.max(0,P.grab-dt*2);

}

  big('KONTUZJA','Karetka odwiozła Cię na osiedle: -'+lost+' zł','#ff5050',3);sfx.fail();respawn();}

function hurt(d,kx,kz){if(P.car||state!=='play'||dlgOn||mt.on||duel)return;P.hp-=d;P.lastHurt=time;sfx.hurt();$('hurt').style.opacity=1;setTimeout(()=>$('hurt').style.opacity=0,200);shake=Math.max(shake,.45);if(kx!=null){P.vel.x=kx;P.vel.z=kz;}if(P.hp<=0){P.hp=0;wasted();}}

function mkCop(x,z,h){const c=newCar('#f4f4f4','police');c.glow.material.opacity=.05;c.mode='pursuit';c.x=x;c.z=z;c.h=h;c.speed=0;c.stuck=0;c.rev=0;c.stun=0;c.wt=0;c.wx=x;c.wz=z;pursuit.push(c);return c;}
function spawnPursuit(){const cx=W.seen?P.pos.x:W.last.x,cz=W.seen?P.pos.z:W.last.z;for(let t=0;t<60;t++){const i=randi(0,N),ax=Math.random()<.5,al=rand(BMIN+5,BMAX-5);const x=ax?XL[i]:al,z=ax?al:ZL[i];const d=Math.hypot(x-cx,z-cz),dp=Math.hypot(x-P.pos.x,z-P.pos.z);if(d<55||d>120||dp<50||blockAt(x,z))continue;
  const c=mkCop(x,z,Math.atan2(cx-x,cz-z));c.speed=8;return;}}
function roadblock(){const c=P.car;if(!c)return;const vx=c.vel.x,vz=c.vel.z;if(Math.hypot(vx,vz)<9)return;const alongX=Math.abs(vx)>Math.abs(vz),sg=Math.sign(alongX?vx:vz);
  if(alongX){const rz=nearL(ZL,c.z);if(Math.abs(c.z-rz)>7)return;const x=c.x+sg*95;if(x<BMIN+12||x>BMAX-12||(x>RX0-8&&x<RX1+8))return;for(const o of[-3.7,3.7]){const b=mkCop(x,rz+o,0);b.parked=true;b.parkT=22;b.block=true;}}
  else{const rx=nearL(XL,c.x);if(Math.abs(c.x-rx)>7)return;const z=c.z+sg*95;if(z<BMIN+12||z>BMAX-12)return;for(const o of[-3.7,3.7]){const b=mkCop(rx+o,z,Math.PI/2);b.parked=true;b.parkT=22;b.block=true;}}
  feed('🚧 Blokada na drodze przed Tobą!');}
function updatePursuit(dt){
  const hot=heat>=1&&!mt.on,st=Math.floor(heat),want=hot?[0,0,1,2,2,3][st]:0;pspawnT-=dt;if(pursuit.filter(c=>!c.parked).length<want&&pspawnT<=0){spawnPursuit();pspawnT=4;}
  if(hot&&st>=3&&P.car){W.blkT-=dt;if(W.blkT<=0){W.blkT=16;roadblock();}}
  let close=false;
  for(const c of pursuit.slice()){
    const d=Math.hypot(c.x-P.pos.x,c.z-P.pos.z);
    if(d>170||(!hot&&d>40)||(c.parked&&(c.parkT-=dt)<0&&d>30)){removeCar(c);continue;}
    const lb=c.mesh.g.userData.lb;if(lb)lb.material.color.copy(Math.floor(time*8)%2?hdr('#2060ff',7):hdr('#ff2030',7));
    if(c.stun>0){c.stun-=dt;c.h+=dt*7;c.speed=0;c.vel.set(0,0,0);continue;}
    if(c.parked||!hot){c.speed*=Math.max(0,1-4*dt);c.vel.set(Math.sin(c.h)*c.speed,0,Math.cos(c.h)*c.speed);c.x+=c.vel.x*dt;c.z+=c.vel.z*dt;if(c.block&&P.car&&d<7&&Math.abs(P.car.speed)<4)close=true;continue;}
    if(!P.car&&W.seen&&d<13){c.parked=true;c.parkT=14;spawnStrazAt(c.x+Math.cos(c.h)*1.9,c.z-Math.sin(c.h)*1.9);continue;}
    let slow=false;for(const cl of clouds)if(Math.hypot(cl.x-c.x,cl.z-c.z)<9)slow=true;
    let tx,tz,maxS;
    if(W.seen){const lead=P.car?.7:0;tx=P.pos.x+(P.car?P.car.vel.x*lead:0);tz=P.pos.z+(P.car?P.car.vel.z*lead:0);maxS=19.5+.6*st;
      if(P.car&&d<9){const ps=Math.hypot(P.car.vel.x,P.car.vel.z);maxS=Math.max(3,ps-1.5);const sx=Math.cos(P.car.h),sz2=-Math.sin(P.car.h),side=((c.x-P.car.x)*sx+(c.z-P.car.z)*sz2)>0?1:-1;tx=P.car.x+sx*side*3.4+Math.sin(P.car.h)*6;tz=P.car.z+sz2*side*3.4+Math.cos(P.car.h)*6;}}
    else{c.wt-=dt;if(c.wt<=0||Math.hypot(c.wx-c.x,c.wz-c.z)<8){c.wt=rand(5,9);const i=clamp(lineIdx(XL,W.last.x)+randi(-1,1),0,N),k=clamp(lineIdx(ZL,W.last.z)+randi(-1,1),0,N);c.wx=XL[i];c.wz=ZL[k];}tx=c.wx;tz=c.wz;maxS=10;}
    steerTo(c,tx,tz,slow?5:maxS,dt);
    if(P.car&&d<6.5&&Math.abs(P.car.speed)<3)close=true;
  }
  if(close&&W.seen){bustT+=dt;prompt('Straż Cię blokuje – <b>ruszaj!</b>');if(bustT>2.4)busted();}else bustT=Math.max(0,bustT-dt);
}

function spawnRival(x,z,o){o=o||{};for(let t=0;t<30&&(insideBuilding(x,z,.6)||groundH(x,z)<0||x<BMIN+2||x>BMAX-2||z<BMIN+2||z>BMAX-2);t++){x+=rand(-3,3);z+=rand(-3,3);}
  if(groundH(x,z)<0){x=x<(RX0+RX1)/2?RX0-9:RX1+9;}
  const suit=o.suit;const h=makeHuman(suit?{shirt:'#2a2a32',shorts:'#2a2a32',pants:true,shoes:'#111111',collar:'#ffffff',bald:Math.random()<.5,belly:Math.random()<.4,build:2,face:{eye:3,brow:1,mouth:4,beard:pick([0,1,2]),glasses:Math.random()<.4?1:0}}
    :{shirt:'#ffcc33',shorts:'#15151c',socks:'#ffcc33',shoes:'#111111',stripe:'#15151c',cap:Math.random()<.4?'#15151c':null,bald:Math.random()<.3,belly:Math.random()<.3,build:pick([1,2]),face:{eye:3,brow:1,mouth:pick([1,4]),beard:pick([0,1,3]),glasses:0}});blob(h,1.2);
  const r={h,pos:new V3(x,Math.max(0,groundH(x,z)),z),vel:new V3(),hp:o.hp||3,hpMax:o.hp||3,stun:0,atk:0,home:{x,z},guardR:o.guardR||0,dead:false,t:0,lunge:0,tag:o.tag};h.root.position.copy(r.pos);const hb=new THREE.Group();hb.position.set(0,2.75,0);r.hpBars=[];const lc=document.createElement('canvas');lc.width=384;lc.height=96;const lt=new THREE.CanvasTexture(lc);const lsp=new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({map:lt,depthTest:false,transparent:true}));lsp.scale.set(2.6,.65,1);lsp.position.y=.2;lsp.renderOrder=41;hb.add(lsp);
  r.hpLab=()=>{const x=lc.getContext('2d');x.clearRect(0,0,384,96);const n=r.hpMax,hp=Math.max(0,r.hp),w=Math.min(64,340/n),x0=192-(n*w)/2;x.fillStyle='rgba(10,8,16,.8)';x.beginPath();x.roundRect?x.roundRect(x0-12,8,n*w+24,80,18):x.rect(x0-12,8,n*w+24,80);x.fill();x.font='900 '+Math.round(w*.95)+'px Arial';x.textAlign='center';x.textBaseline='middle';for(let i=0;i<n;i++){x.fillStyle=i<hp?(hp/n>.55?'#ff3b5c':hp/n>.25?'#ffb02e':'#ff5a1f'):'rgba(255,255,255,.18)';x.fillText('♥',x0+w*(i+.5),52);}lt.needsUpdate=true;};r.hpLab();h.root.add(hb);rivals.push(r);return r;}
function hurtRival(r,d){if(r.dead)return;if(!ball.hidden&&Math.hypot(ball.pos.x-r.pos.x,ball.pos.z-r.pos.z)<2.5)ball.hitBack=.7;r.hp-=d;r.stun=2.3;r.guardR=0;for(let i=0;i<r.hpBars.length;i++){const m=r.hpBars[i];m.visible=i<Math.max(0,r.hp);if(m.visible)m.material.color.set(r.hp/r.hpMax>.55?'#6dffa0':r.hp/r.hpMax>.25?'#ffcc33':'#ff5050');}if(r.hpLab)r.hpLab();floatText('-1 ♥',r.pos.x,2.4,r.pos.z,'#ff5050',22);sfx.thud();addSup(6);if(r.hp<=0){r.dead=true;r.t=0;floatText(pick(['Do szatni!','Pokonany!','Auć!','Zmiana!','Noszę!']),r.pos.x,2.6,r.pos.z,'#ffcc33',22);addResp(1);ev('RivalDown',r);}}
function updateRivals(dt){
  const bs=ball.vel.length();
  for(const r of rivals.slice()){
    if(r.dead){r.t+=dt;r.h.root.rotation.x=lerp(r.h.root.rotation.x,-Math.PI/2,.2);if(r.t>3){killHuman(r.h);rivals.splice(rivals.indexOf(r),1);}continue;}
    const dx0=P.pos.x-r.pos.x,dz0=P.pos.z-r.pos.z,dP=Math.hypot(dx0,dz0);
    if(!ball.hidden&&bs>8){const bx=ball.pos.x-r.pos.x,bz=ball.pos.z-r.pos.z;if(bx*bx+bz*bz<.45&&ball.pos.y<r.pos.y+1.9){hurtRival(r,1);ball.vel.x*=-.3;ball.vel.z*=-.3;ball.vel.y=4;floatText('TRAFIONY!',r.pos.x,2.6,r.pos.z,'#33e6ff');}}
    if(P.car){const cs=Math.hypot(P.car.vel.x,P.car.vel.z);if(dP<1.7&&cs>4&&r.stun<=0){hurtRival(r,1);sfx.thud();continue;}}
    if(r.stun>0){r.stun-=dt;r.h.root.rotation.x=lerp(r.h.root.rotation.x,-1.45,.25);if(r.stun<=0)r.h.root.rotation.x=0;continue;}
    if(r.wait>0){r.wait-=dt;r.h.root.rotation.y=Math.atan2(dx0,dz0);animHuman(r.h,dt,0,{talk:true});r.h.root.position.copy(r.pos);r.h.shadow.position.set(r.pos.x,r.pos.y+.03,r.pos.z);continue;}
    let conf=false;for(const c of clouds)if(Math.hypot(c.x-r.pos.x,c.z-r.pos.z)<7.5)conf=true;
    let tx,tz,sp=6.6+.1*tier()+(r.tag==='col'?.9:0);
    if(r.guardR>0&&dP>r.guardR){tx=r.home.x;tz=r.home.z;sp=Math.hypot(tx-r.pos.x,tz-r.pos.z)<.6?0:2.5;}else{r.guardR=0;tx=P.pos.x;tz=P.pos.z;}
    if(conf){tx=r.pos.x+Math.sin(time*3+r.pos.z)*4;tz=r.pos.z+Math.cos(time*2.1+r.pos.x)*4;sp=2.5;}
    let dx=tx-r.pos.x,dz=tz-r.pos.z;const d=Math.hypot(dx,dz)||1;dx/=d;dz/=d;if(r.lunge>0){r.lunge-=dt;sp=10;}
    r.vel.x+=(dx*sp-r.vel.x)*Math.min(1,dt*5);r.vel.z+=(dz*sp-r.vel.z)*Math.min(1,dt*5);r.pos.x+=r.vel.x*dt;r.pos.z+=r.vel.z*dt;{const hit=pushOutCircle(r.pos,.4);if(hit&&!r.air&&d>1.6){r.blk=(r.blk||0)+dt;if(r.blk>.3){const px=r.pos.x+dx*1.1,pz=r.pos.z+dz*1.1;if(!insideBuilding(px,pz,.1)){r.air=true;r.vy=7.2;r.blk=0;}else r.blk=-.6;}}else if(!hit)r.blk=0;}
    for(const o of rivals)if(o!==r&&!o.dead){const ox=r.pos.x-o.pos.x,oz=r.pos.z-o.pos.z,od=Math.hypot(ox,oz);if(od<.95&&od>0){r.pos.x+=ox/od*(.95-od)*.5;r.pos.z+=oz/od*(.95-od)*.5;}}
    if(r.air){r.vy-=19*dt;r.pos.y+=r.vy*dt;const gq=Math.max(0,groundH(r.pos.x,r.pos.z));if(r.pos.y<=gq&&r.vy<0){r.pos.y=gq;r.air=false;}}else r.pos.y=lerp(r.pos.y,Math.max(0,groundH(r.pos.x,r.pos.z)),.3);r.atk-=dt;
    const v=Math.hypot(r.vel.x,r.vel.z);r.h.root.position.copy(r.pos);if(v>.3)r.h.root.rotation.y=Math.atan2(r.vel.x,r.vel.z);animHuman(r.h,dt,v,{slide:r.lunge>0});r.h.shadow.position.set(r.pos.x,r.pos.y+.03,r.pos.z);
    if(!P.car&&!conf&&!dlgOn&&r.guardR<=0){if(dP<3.2&&dP>1.3&&r.atk<=0&&r.lunge<=0){r.lunge=.35;r.atk=2;}
      if(dP<1.15&&r.lunge>0&&P.pos.y<r.pos.y+.55&&P.slide<=0){r.lunge=0;hurt(11+tier(),dx0/dP*7,dz0/dP*7);P.stun=.35;if(r.tag==='col'&&cash>0&&debt>0){const v=Math.min(cash,debt,Math.max(25,Math.round(cash*.06/5)*5));cash-=v;debt-=v;floatText('-'+v+' zł NA DŁUG',P.pos.x,3.2,P.pos.z,'#ff5050',22);}floatText(pick(['FAUL!','Wślizg!','Auć!']),P.pos.x,2.6,P.pos.z,'#ff5050',22);}}
  }
}
function inCone(dx,dz,d){return d<.01||(dx*P.face.x+dz*P.face.z)/d>.4;}
function areaHit(x,z,r,o){let n=0;o=o||{};
  for(const p of peds){if(p.state!=='walk')continue;const dx=p.x-x,dz=p.z-z,d=Math.hypot(dx,dz);if(d<r&&(!o.cone||inCone(dx,dz,d))){knockPed(p,dx/(d||1)*(o.pow||5),o.up||4,dz/(d||1)*(o.pow||5));n++;addHeat(.4);}}
  for(const s of straz){if(s.stun>0)continue;const dx=s.pos.x-x,dz=s.pos.z-z,d=Math.hypot(dx,dz);if(d<r&&(!o.cone||inCone(dx,dz,d))){s.stun=o.stun||3.5;addHeat(.3);n++;floatText(pick(['Uff!','Ała!','Wezwę posiłki!']),s.pos.x,2.5,s.pos.z,'#33e6ff');sfx.thud();}}
  for(const rv of rivals){if(rv.dead||(rv.stun>0&&!o.force))continue;const dx=rv.pos.x-x,dz=rv.pos.z-z,d=Math.hypot(dx,dz);if(d<r&&(!o.cone||inCone(dx,dz,d))){hurtRival(rv,o.dmg||1);n++;}}
  for(const b of mt.bots){if(b.stun>0||b.team===0)continue;const dx=b.pos.x-x,dz=b.pos.z-z,d=Math.hypot(dx,dz);if(d<r&&(!o.cone||inCone(dx,dz,d))){b.stun=1.3;n++;sfx.thud();}}
  return n;}

// ---------- bramkarz ----------
function updateKeeper(G,dt){
  const k=G.keeper;if(!k||!G.active||!k.on){if(k){k.h.root.visible=false;k.h.shadow.visible=false;}return;}
  if(duel&&G===goal&&k.plan&&k.plan!=='none'&&duel.ph==='shot'){k.h.root.visible=true;k.h.shadow.visible=true;k.planT+=dt;
    const f=(ball.pos.x-G.x)*G.nx+(ball.pos.z-G.z)*G.nz,vf=-(ball.vel.x*G.nx+ball.vel.z*G.nz),tt=vf>1?f/vf:1;
    if(!k.pl){const sg=Math.sign(k.planLat)||1,u=Math.abs(k.planLat)/(G.W/2),R_=.95;let side=sg,hl,hy;
      if(k.plan==='save'){hl=k.planLat;hy=k.planY;}
      else if(u>.4&&Math.random()<.45){side=-sg;hl=-sg*(G.W/2-.3);hy=.8;}// zły róg
      else if(u>.4){hl=k.planLat-sg*.45;hy=Math.max(.35,k.planY-.15);}// dobry róg, pełny rzut, piłka mija palce
      else{side=Math.random()<.5?1:-1;hl=side*2.1;hy=.7;}// strzał w środek, a bramkarz w bok
      let th;if(k.plan==='save'&&u<.3){th=0;}else th=clamp(1.5-Math.max(0,hy-.6)*.45,.95,1.5);
      const cl=hl-side*Math.sin(th)*R_,cy=Math.max(.45,hy-Math.cos(th)*R_);k.pl={cl:clamp(cl,-G.W/2+.2,G.W/2-.2),cy,th,side,T:Math.max(.18,Math.min(.38,tt*.8))};}
    const Q=k.pl,t0=k.planT-.05;let cl=0,cy=1.0,th=0;if(t0>0){const u=Math.min(1,t0/Q.T),e=1-(1-u)*(1-u);cl=Q.cl*e;th=Q.th*e;cy=1.0+(Q.cy-1.0)*e+Math.sin(u*Math.PI)*.45*(Q.th>0?1:0);
      if(t0>Q.T&&Q.th>0){const f2=Math.min(1,(t0-Q.T)/.32);cy=Q.cy+(.32-Q.cy)*f2*f2;th=Q.th+(1.5-Q.th)*f2;}}// po rzucie spada i leży
    k.lat=cl;const h=k.h,[kx,kz]=keeperPlace(G,h,cl,cy,Q.side*th);animHuman(h,0,0);h.armL.rotation.x=h.armR.rotation.x=-2.95;h.armL.rotation.z=.1;h.armR.rotation.z=-.1;h.shadow.position.set(kx,G.y+.03,kz);
    if(k.plan==='save'&&f<.7&&f>-.5&&!k.saved){k.saved=1;const hx=G.x+G.tx*k.planLat+G.nx*.4,hz=G.z+G.tz*k.planLat+G.nz*.4;ball.pos.set(hx,G.y+Math.max(.25,k.planY),hz);const sg=Math.sign(k.planLat||(Math.random()-.5));ball.vel.set(G.nx*rand(6,9)+G.tx*sg*rand(4,7),rand(2.5,5),G.nz*rand(6,9)+G.tz*sg*rand(4,7));G.prev=null;burst(hx,G.y+Math.max(.25,k.planY),hz,26,6,['#ffffff','#ffcc33']);floatText(pick(['OBRONA!','PARADA!','NIE TYM RAZEM!','MAM!']),kx,3,kz,'#ffcc33',26);sfx.save();shake=.3;hitStop=.06;}
    return;}
  if(k.plan&&!(duel&&duel.ph==='shot')){if(k.pl&&k.pl.th>0){k.dir=k.pl.side;k.rz=k.pl.side*1.5;k.cy=.32;k.down=.9;}k.plan=null;k.saved=0;k.late=false;k.lateSet=0;k.pl=null;k.py=0;k.pth=0;}
  k.h.root.visible=true;k.h.shadow.visible=true;const S=keeperSkill(k.lvl||1);
  const rx=ball.pos.x-G.x,rz=ball.pos.z-G.z,f=rx*G.nx+rz*G.nz,lat=rx*G.tx+rz*G.tz;
  const vf=ball.vel.x*G.nx+ball.vel.z*G.nz,vl=ball.vel.x*G.tx+ball.vel.z*G.tz;
  let target=k.pre!=null?k.pre:clamp(lat*.45,-G.W/2+.6,G.W/2-.6);
  if(k.fooled>0){k.fooled-=dt;if(k.fooled<=0){k.dive=0;}}
  else if(vf<-5&&f>0&&f<40&&!ball.hidden&&!lockBall){k.react-=dt;if(k.react<=0){const tt=f/-vf;const pred=lat+vl*tt;target=clamp(pred,-G.W/2-.4,G.W/2+.4);k.target=target;
      if(tt<.6&&k.dive<=0&&Math.abs(target-k.lat)>.75&&Math.abs(pred)<G.W/2+.5&&-vf>9){if(Math.random()<S.dive){k.dive=.55;k.dir=Math.sign(target-k.lat);k.dy=clamp(ball.pos.y+ball.vel.y*tt-.5*GRAV*tt*tt-G.y,.45,1.6);k.dspd=Math.min(S.dmax*1.3,Math.abs(target-k.lat)/Math.max(.1,tt)*1.25+1.5);}else{k.dive=-1;}}}else target=k.target!=null?k.target:target;}
  else{k.react=S.react;if(k.dive<0)k.dive=0;k.target=null;}
  if(k.dive>0){k.dive-=dt;k.lat+=k.dir*k.dspd*dt;if(k.dive<=0&&!(k.fooled>0))k.dive=0;}else if(!(k.fooled>0)&&!(k.down>0)){const ks=S.spd*(vf<-5&&f>0?.4:1);k.lat+=clamp(target-k.lat,-ks*dt,ks*dt);}
  k.lat=clamp(k.lat,-G.W/2-.3,G.W/2+.3);
  const kx=G.x+G.tx*k.lat+G.nx*.35,kz=G.z+G.tz*k.lat+G.nz*.35;const h=k.h,diving=k.dive>0||k.fooled>0;
  if(k.dive>0)k.down=.5;else if(k.down>0)k.down-=dt;const pr=k.dive>0?1-k.dive/.55:1,lying=k.dive<=0&&k.down>0;const tgtR=diving?k.dir*Math.min(1.4,pr*2.4):lying?k.dir*1.5:0;k.rz=(k.rz||0)+(tgtR-(k.rz||0))*Math.min(1,dt*(diving?14:lying?10:6));const ccy=diving?1.0+((k.dy||.6)-1.0)*Math.min(1,pr*1.6)+Math.sin(Math.min(1,pr)*Math.PI)*.2:lying?.32:1.0;k.cy=(k.cy==null?1:k.cy)+(ccy-(k.cy==null?1:k.cy))*Math.min(1,dt*(diving?16:8));keeperPlace(G,h,k.lat,k.cy,k.rz);
  if(k.kickT>0)k.kickT-=dt;if(diving){animHuman(h,dt,0);h.armL.rotation.x=h.armR.rotation.x=-2.9;}else if(k.kickT>0)animHuman(h,dt,0,{kick:k.kickT});else animHuman(h,dt,Math.abs(target-k.lat)>.2?2:0,{keeperReady:true});
  h.shadow.position.set(kx,G.y+.03,kz);
  if(ball.rocket>0)return;
  // w rzucie ciało leży poziomo w stronę k.dir: strefa obrony pokrywa dokładnie to, co widać (od bioder po dłonie)
  const reach=diving?1.05:.4,off=diving?k.dir*.35:0,hgt=diving?.9:1.95,yMin=G.y+(diving?Math.max(0,(k.cy||1)-.45):0);
  const bx=kx+G.tx*off,bz=kz+G.tz*off,hxW=Math.abs(G.tx)*reach+Math.abs(G.nx)*.3,hzW=Math.abs(G.tz)*reach+Math.abs(G.nz)*.3;
  const v=sphereBox(ball,{minX:bx-hxW,maxX:bx+hxW,minY:yMin,maxY:yMin+hgt,minZ:bz-hzW,maxZ:bz+hzW},.35);if(v>3)burst(ball.pos.x,ball.pos.y,ball.pos.z,18,5,['#ffffff','#ffcc33']);
  if(v>3&&time-(k.lastSave||-9)>.8){k.lastSave=time;floatText(pick(['OBRONA!','PARADA!','NIE TYM RAZEM!','MAM!']),kx,3,kz,'#ffcc33',26);sfx.save();shake=.25;ev('Save',G);}
  if(!duel&&!lockBall&&!P.hasBall&&!ball.hidden&&time-(k.lastClear||-9)>1.1&&time-(k.lastSave||-9)>.25){const bs=Math.hypot(ball.vel.x,ball.vel.z),dk=Math.hypot(ball.pos.x-kx,ball.pos.z-kz),bf=(ball.pos.x-G.x)*G.nx+(ball.pos.z-G.z)*G.nz;if(dk<1.7&&bs<7&&ball.pos.y<G.y+1.5&&bf>-.3&&bf<4.5){k.lastClear=time;k.kickT=.32;const s=rand(-.4,.4),pw=rand(15,19);ball.pos.set(kx+G.nx*.6,Math.max(ball.pos.y,G.y+R+.1),kz+G.nz*.6);ball.vel.set((G.nx+G.tx*s)*pw,rand(5.5,8),(G.nz+G.tz*s)*pw);ball.curveT=0;ball.rocket=0;G.prev=null;if(mt.on)ball.owner=G===goal?1:0;floatText(pick(['WYBITA!','PRECZ Z NIĄ!','DO PRZODU!']),kx,2.6,kz,'#ffffff',20);sfx.kick(.7);}}
}

// ---------- kamera ----------
const cam={yaw:0,pitch:.3,dist:5.6,pos:new V3(),tgt:new V3(),lastLook:-9,init:false};
const _cs=[];
function updateCamera(rdt){
  if(camLock){camera.position.lerp(camLock.pos,1-Math.exp(-6*rdt));cam.tgt.lerp(camLock.tgt,1-Math.exp(-8*rdt));camera.lookAt(cam.tgt);cam.pos.copy(camera.position);const fv=camLock.fov||50;if(Math.abs(camera.fov-fv)>.05){camera.fov=lerp(camera.fov,fv,Math.min(1,rdt*5));camera.updateProjectionMatrix();}
    sun.position.set(cam.tgt.x+SUN.x*160,SUN.y*160+60,cam.tgt.z+SUN.z*160);sun.target.position.set(cam.tgt.x,0,cam.tgt.z);return;}
  const inCar=!!P.car;const focus=inCar?new V3(P.car.x,1.6+(P.car.y||0),P.car.z):new V3(P.pos.x,P.pos.y+1.42,P.pos.z);if(inCar){const sp=Math.hypot(P.car.vel.x,P.car.vel.z);cam.spd=cam.spd==null?sp:cam.spd+(sp-cam.spd)*Math.min(1,rdt*1.5);}else cam.spd=0;
  if(inCar){const c=P.car,sp=Math.hypot(c.vel.x,c.vel.z);if(time-cam.lastLook>1.2&&sp>2){const vy=Math.atan2(-c.vel.x,-c.vel.z);cam.yaw+=angDiff(cam.yaw,c.speed<-1?c.h:vy)*Math.min(1,rdt*2.8);cam.pitch=lerp(cam.pitch,.22,rdt*2);}}
  const dist=inCar?8.8+Math.min(3,cam.spd*.08):(charging?4.4:cam.dist);
  const rx=Math.cos(cam.yaw),rz=-Math.sin(cam.yaw);const sh=inCar?0:.62;
  const tgt=new V3(focus.x+rx*sh,focus.y,focus.z+rz*sh);
  const off=new V3(Math.sin(cam.yaw)*Math.cos(cam.pitch),Math.sin(cam.pitch),Math.cos(cam.yaw)*Math.cos(cam.pitch));
  nearStatics(tgt.x,tgt.z,_cs);let dd=dist;
  for(let t=.4;t<=dist;t+=.25){const px=tgt.x+off.x*t,py=tgt.y+off.y*t,pz=tgt.z+off.z*t;let hit=py<.3;
    if(!hit)for(const c of _cs){if(c.fence)continue;if(px>c.minX-.3&&px<c.maxX+.3&&pz>c.minZ-.3&&pz<c.maxZ+.3&&py<c.maxY+.3){hit=true;break;}}

  const want=tgt.clone().addScaledVector(off,dd);

  camera.position.copy(cam.pos);
  if(shake>0){shake=Math.max(0,shake-rdt*1.8);camera.position.x+=(Math.random()-.5)*shake*.5;camera.position.y+=(Math.random()-.5)*shake*.5;camera.position.z+=(Math.random()-.5)*shake*.5;}
  camera.lookAt(cam.tgt);
  let fov=62;if(inCar)fov+=Math.min(12,cam.spd*.35);else if(Math.hypot(P.vel.x,P.vel.z)>8)fov+=5;if(charging)fov-=6*charge;fovPunch=Math.max(0,fovPunch-rdt*30);fov+=fovPunch;
  if(Math.abs(camera.fov-fov)>.05){camera.fov=lerp(camera.fov,fov,Math.min(1,rdt*6));camera.updateProjectionMatrix();}
  {const sx=Math.round(focus.x/2)*2,sz=Math.round(focus.z/2)*2;sun.position.set(sx+SUN.x*160,SUN.y*160+60,sz+SUN.z*160);sun.target.position.set(sx,0,sz);}
}

function solveShot(src,T,s,out,force){const dx=T.x-src.x,dz=T.z-src.z,d=Math.max(.6,Math.hypot(dx,dz)),h=T.y-src.y,g=GRAV;
  if(force){const smin=Math.sqrt(g*(h+Math.sqrt(h*h+d*d)))*1.03;if(s<smin)s=smin;}
  const disc=s*s*s*s-g*(g*d*d+2*h*s*s);let th=disc<0?Math.PI/4:Math.atan((s*s-Math.sqrt(disc))/(g*d));const c=Math.cos(th);out.set(dx/d*s*c,s*Math.sin(th),dz/d*s*c);return out;}

function doKick(p){
  if(P.stun>0)return;P.kickT=.32;
  if(!inReach()){feed('Za daleko od piłki');return;}
  const rocket=armed;shotVel(p,ball.pos,_kv,rocket?1.55:1);
  if(p>.97&&!rocket){const e=.07;_kv.x+=rand(-e,e)*_kv.length();_kv.z+=rand(-e,e)*_kv.length();_kv.y*=rand(1,1.25);floatText('ZA MOCNO!',ball.pos.x,ball.pos.y+1.4,ball.pos.z,'#ff5050',20);}
  if(goal.active&&!lockBall){const gx=goal.x-ball.pos.x,gz=goal.z-ball.pos.z,gd=Math.hypot(gx,gz),vh=Math.hypot(_kv.x,_kv.z);if(gd<24&&vh>4){const ang=angDiff(Math.atan2(_kv.x,_kv.z),Math.atan2(gx,gz));if(Math.abs(ang)<.32){const na=Math.atan2(_kv.x,_kv.z)-ang*.3;_kv.x=Math.sin(na)*vh;_kv.z=Math.cos(na)*vh;}}}
  ball.vel.copy(_kv);lastKick={x:ball.pos.x,z:ball.pos.z};kickCd=.4;ball.owner=0;ball.spin=0;ball.curveT=p>.45?.75:0;ball.rocket=0;if(lockBall)lockBall=null;
  if(rocket){ball.rocket=1.6;armed=false;sup=0;floatText('RAKIETA!!!',ball.pos.x,ball.pos.y+1.6,ball.pos.z,'#ff7a2d',32);sfx.boom();shake=.8;slowmo=.5;}
  hitStop=.045+p*.03;fovPunch=3+p*5;shake=Math.max(shake,.15+p*.35);sfx.kick(p);if(p>.6)slowmo=Math.max(slowmo,.28);
  burst(ball.pos.x,ball.pos.y,ball.pos.z,6+Math.round(p*14),4+p*6,['#ffffff','#ffcc33']);
  if(ball.pos.y>Math.max(0,groundH(ball.pos.x,ball.pos.z))+.9){floatText(jug.count>=3?'WOLEJ PO ŻONGLERCE!':'WOLEJ!',ball.pos.x,ball.pos.y+1,ball.pos.z,'#33e6ff',22);addResp(1);addSup(6+jug.count);}
  endJug(false);ev('Kick',p);
}

function explode(x,y,z){
  bomb.active=false;bomb.mesh.visible=bomb.shadow.visible=false;burst(x,y+.5,z,220,17,['#ff7a2d','#ffcc33','#ffffff','#ff3020']);sfx.boom();shake=1;hitStop=.07;

  animHuman(h,dt,P.celebrate>0||P.slide>0?0:spd,{air:!P.ground&&P.slide<=0,slide:P.slide>0,charge:charging?charge:0,kick:P.kickT>0?P.kickT:0,jug:P.jugT>0?P.jugT:0,celebrate:P.celebrate>0,card:P.cardT>0,blow:P.blowT>0,
    hold:!mt.on&&(holdBall||(cur==='bomba'&&ammo.bomba>0)),carry:carryProp});
  h.shadow.position.set(P.pos.x,gh+.03,P.pos.z);pRing.position.set(P.pos.x,gh+.04,P.pos.z);
  if(charging)charge=Math.min(1,charge+dt/.8);
}
function driveCar(c,dt){
  let thr=0,st=0;if(!dlgOn&&!wheel.open){if(keys.KeyW||keys.ArrowUp)thr+=1;if(keys.KeyS||keys.ArrowDown)thr-=1;if(keys.KeyA||keys.ArrowLeft)st+=1;if(keys.KeyD||keys.ArrowRight)st-=1;}
  const hb=keys.Space,nitro=(keys.ShiftLeft||keys.ShiftRight)&&P.stam>2&&thr>0;
  if(nitro){P.stam-=26*dt;if(Math.random()<.5)burst(c.x-Math.sin(c.h)*2.4,.5,c.z-Math.cos(c.h)*2.4,2,2,['#33e6ff','#ffffff']);}else P.stam=Math.min(maxStam(),P.stam+12*dt);
  const vmax=(c.vmax||24)*(1+.06*up.car)+(c.fast||0)+(nitro?8:0),acc=(c.acc||9)*(1+.08*up.car)*(nitro?1.7:1);
  if(thr>0){if(c.speed<-.5)c.speed+=26*dt;else c.speed+=acc*thr*Math.max(0,1-Math.pow(Math.max(0,c.speed)/vmax,1.7))*dt+(c.speed>vmax?-(c.speed-vmax)*dt*1.5:0);}
  else if(thr<0){if(c.speed>.5)c.speed+=thr*24*dt;else c.speed=Math.max(-8,c.speed+thr*8*dt);}else c.speed*=1-.45*dt;
  if(hb)c.speed*=1-1.5*dt;
  c.steer=lerp(c.steer,st,Math.min(1,dt*7));
  const rate=2.5*(1-Math.min(.6,Math.abs(c.speed)/46));c.h+=c.steer*rate*dt*clamp(c.speed/6,-1,1)*(hb?1.4:1);
  const fx=Math.sin(c.h),fz=Math.cos(c.h);const grip=hb?1.3:7;
  c.vel.x+=(fx*c.speed-c.vel.x)*Math.min(1,grip*dt);c.vel.z+=(fz*c.speed-c.vel.z)*Math.min(1,grip*dt);
  c.slip=Math.abs(c.vel.x*fz-c.vel.z*fx);
  c.x+=c.vel.x*dt;c.z+=c.vel.z*dt;
  for(const off of[1.4,-1.4]){const p={x:c.x+fx*off,z:c.z+fz*off};const bx=p.x,bz=p.z;const hit=pushOutCircle(p,1.05);
    if(hit){c.x+=p.x-bx;c.z+=p.z-bz;const vn=c.vel.x*hit[0]+c.vel.z*hit[1];if(vn<-4)crash(-vn);if(vn<0){c.vel.x-=1.35*vn*hit[0];c.vel.z-=1.35*vn*hit[1];}c.speed=c.vel.x*fx+c.vel.z*fz;}}
  for(const o of cars){if(o===c)continue;if(Math.abs(o.x-c.x)>6||Math.abs(o.z-c.z)>6)continue;const ofx=Math.sin(o.h),ofz=Math.cos(o.h);
    for(const a of[1.4,-1.4])for(const b of[1.4,-1.4]){const ax=c.x+fx*a,az=c.z+fz*a,bx2=o.x+ofx*b,bz2=o.z+ofz*b;const dx=ax-bx2,dz=az-bz2,d=Math.hypot(dx,dz);
      if(d<2.15&&d>0){const nx=dx/d,nz=dz/d,pen=2.15-d,cop=o.mode==='pursuit'&&!o.parked;if(cop){c.x+=nx*pen*.5;c.z+=nz*pen*.5;o.x-=nx*pen*.5;o.z-=nz*pen*.5;}else{c.x+=nx*pen;c.z+=nz*pen;}
        const rv=(c.vel.x-o.vel.x)*nx+(c.vel.z-o.vel.z)*nz;if(rv<0){const k=cop?.6:1.3;c.vel.x-=k*rv*nx;c.vel.z-=k*rv*nz;c.speed=c.vel.x*fx+c.vel.z*fz;
          if(-rv>5){crash(-rv);ev('CarHit',o,-rv);if(o.mode==='traffic'){o.speed=0;o.honk=3;if(!o.flee)addHeat(.25);}else if(o.mode==='pursuit'&&-rv>8){o.stun=o.block?2.5:1.6;o.parked=false;o.block=false;addHeat(.3);addSup(10);floatText('RADIOWÓZ ZEPCHNIĘTY!',o.x,3,o.z,'#33e6ff',22);}}}}}}
  for(const s of stands)if(s.alive&&Math.hypot(s.x-c.x,s.z-c.z)<2.3&&Math.abs(c.speed)>4){smashStand(s);crash(8);}
  if(Math.abs(c.speed)>3.5){propsNear(c.x,c.z,_pn);for(const q of _pn){if(q.down)continue;for(const off of[1.5,0,-1.5]){if(Math.hypot(q.x-(c.x+fx*off),q.z-(c.z+fz*off))<q.r+1.15){knockProp(q,Math.atan2(c.vel.x,c.vel.z),Math.abs(c.speed));c.speed*=q.kind==='bin'||q.kind==='cone'?.97:.9;shake=Math.max(shake,q.kind==='bin'||q.kind==='cone'?.12:.3);if(!c.noHeat&&q.kind!=='bin'&&q.kind!=='cone')addHeat(.08);break;}}}}
  if(Math.abs(c.speed)>6&&treeIM){const tl=treeGrid.get(Math.floor(c.x/16)+','+Math.floor(c.z/16));if(tl)for(const q of tl)if(!q.down&&Math.hypot(q.x-c.x,q.z-c.z)<1.7){knockTree(q,c.h);c.speed*=.8;shake=Math.max(shake,.5);if(!c.noHeat)addHeat(.15);}}
  if(Math.abs(c.speed)>5){const l=lampGrid.get(Math.floor(c.x/16)+','+Math.floor(c.z/16));if(l)for(const q of l)if(!q.down&&Math.hypot(q.x-c.x,q.z-c.z)<1.5){knockLamp(q,c.h);burst(q.x,1.5,q.z,26,7,['#ffe6b8','#ffffff','#ffcc33']);sfx.clang();c.speed*=.94;shake=Math.max(shake,.35);if(!c.noHeat)addHeat(.12);}}
  {const rd=Math.hypot(c.x-RONDO.x,c.z-RONDO.z),on=rd<RONDO.r+.6;if(on&&!c.onIsl&&Math.abs(c.speed)>3){crash(Math.min(14,Math.abs(c.speed)*.6));shake=Math.max(shake,.45);c.speed*=.75;floatText('KRAWĘŻNIK!',c.x,2.4,c.z,'#ffcc33',20);}c.onIsl=on;if(on){c.speed*=Math.max(0,1-1.6*dt);}}
  placeCarMesh(c,dt);
}
const _pn=[];function crash(v){if(time-(crash.last||0)<.25)return;crash.last=time;sfx.crash(Math.min(1,v/20));shake=Math.max(shake,Math.min(.9,v*.04));if(P.car)burst(P.car.x,1,P.car.z,8,5,['#ffffff','#ffcc33']);ev('Crash',v);}

function updateBallControl(dt){
  kickCd-=dt;P.touchT-=dt;if(ball.hidden||P.car||P.stun>0||P.slide>0||!P.ground||duel){P.hasBall=false;return;}
  const dx=ball.pos.x-P.pos.x,dz=ball.pos.z-P.pos.z,hd=Math.hypot(dx,dz),gh=Math.max(0,groundH(ball.pos.x,ball.pos.z));
  if(hd<.45&&ball.pos.y<gh+1.2&&hd>0){ball.pos.x=P.pos.x+dx/hd*.45;ball.pos.z=P.pos.z+dz/hd*.45;}
  P.hasBall=false;if(!inv.pilka||(cur!=='pilka'&&!mt.on))return;
  if(kickCd>0||hd>(mt.on?2.1:1.75)||ball.pos.y>gh+R+.6||(jug.active&&ball.pos.y>gh+.6))return;
  P.hasBall=true;ball.owner=0;const sp=Math.hypot(P.vel.x,P.vel.z),k=mt.on?1.5:.75;
  const lead=(mt.on?.42:.8)+sp*(mt.on?.035:.08),tx=P.pos.x+P.face.x*lead,tz=P.pos.z+P.face.z*lead;
  ball.vel.x+=((tx-ball.pos.x)*16*k+(P.vel.x-ball.vel.x)*7*k)*dt;ball.vel.z+=((tz-ball.pos.z)*16*k+(P.vel.z-ball.vel.z)*7*k)*dt;
  if(mt.on&&hd<1.4&&ball.pos.y<gh+R+.3){const lx=P.pos.x+P.face.x*lead,lz=P.pos.z+P.face.z*lead;ball.pos.x+=(lx-ball.pos.x)*Math.min(1,dt*9);ball.pos.z+=(lz-ball.pos.z)*Math.min(1,dt*9);ball.vel.x=P.vel.x;ball.vel.z=P.vel.z;}
  else if(sp>2.5&&P.touchT<=0&&(dx*P.face.x+dz*P.face.z)>.2){ball.vel.x+=P.face.x*(1+sp*.12);ball.vel.z+=P.face.z*(1+sp*.12);P.touchT=sp>8?.26:.34;sfx.touch();}
  if(sp<.5){ball.vel.x*=1-dt*4;ball.vel.z*=1-dt*4;}
}
function updateBall(dt){
  if(bomb.active){bomb.t+=dt;const r=stepBody(bomb,dt);let hit=r.impact>3||r.post||r.carHit||bomb.t>3;
    if(!hit){for(const s of straz)if(Math.hypot(s.pos.x-bomb.pos.x,s.pos.z-bomb.pos.z)<.8)hit=true;for(const q of rivals)if(!q.dead&&Math.hypot(q.pos.x-bomb.pos.x,q.pos.z-bomb.pos.z)<.8)hit=true;}
    if(hit&&bomb.t>.08)explode(bomb.pos.x,bomb.pos.y,bomb.pos.z);}
  if(bigBall.active){const rb=stepBody(bigBall,dt);if(rb.impact>4)sfx.bounce(.8);}
  if(lockBall){ball.pos.copy(lockBall);ball.vel.set(0,0,0);ball.mesh.position.copy(ball.pos);ball.shadow.position.set(ball.pos.x,CURB+.03,ball.pos.z);ballGhost.visible=false;ballRing.visible=true;ballRing.position.set(ball.pos.x,CURB+.04,ball.pos.z);return;}
  if(ball.hidden>0){P.hasBall=false;ballGhost.visible=false;ballRing.visible=false;trail.visible=false;return;}
  ballRing.visible=true;trail.visible=true;
  updateBallControl(dt);
  if(ball.curveT>0){ball.curveT-=dt/Math.max(.2,tsNow);const s=ball.spin*26*dt;ball.vel.x+=Math.cos(cam.yaw)*s;ball.vel.z+=-Math.sin(cam.yaw)*s;if(Math.abs(ball.spin)>.15&&Math.random()<.5)burst(ball.pos.x,ball.pos.y,ball.pos.z,1,1,['#33e6ff']);}
  if(ball.rocket>0){ball.rocket-=dt;burst(ball.pos.x,ball.pos.y,ball.pos.z,3,2,['#ff7a2d','#ffcc33','#ff3020']);if(areaHit(ball.pos.x,ball.pos.z,2.2,{pow:9,up:6,stun:5,dmg:3,force:true}))shake=.5;}
  const r=stepBody(ball,dt);const gh=groundH(ball.pos.x,ball.pos.z);

  if(r.carHit>9){floatText(pick(['ŁUP!','Moja maska!','BANG!']),ball.pos.x,2.6,ball.pos.z,'#ff7a2d');if(!mt.on)addHeat(.2);sfx.thud();for(const c of cars)if((c.flee||c.hitme)&&Math.hypot(c.x-ball.pos.x,c.z-ball.pos.z)<3.8)ev('CarHit',c,r.carHit);}
  const spd=ball.vel.length();
  for(const s of stands)if(s.alive&&spd>7&&Math.abs(ball.pos.x-s.x)<1.3&&Math.abs(ball.pos.z-s.z)<1.3&&ball.pos.y<4.2){smashStand(s);ball.vel.multiplyScalar(.4);addSup(5);}
  for(const t of targets)if(t.on&&spd>5&&Math.hypot(ball.pos.x-t.x,ball.pos.y-t.y,ball.pos.z-t.z)<t.r){hitTarget(t);}
  if(ball.pos.y>gh+3&&spd<1)ball.stuck+=dt;else ball.stuck=0;
  if(ball.stuck>2&&!matchLock)hideBall();
  if(!matchLock&&!P.car&&Math.hypot(ball.pos.x-P.pos.x,ball.pos.z-P.pos.z)>75)hideBall();
  if(!matchLock&&!mt.on&&!lockBall&&!duel&&!P.car&&inv.pilka&&!ball.hidden&&!charging&&!jug.active){const bpd=Math.hypot(ball.pos.x-P.pos.x,ball.pos.z-P.pos.z),bsp=Math.hypot(ball.vel.x,ball.vel.z);ball.age=(ball.age||0)+dt;if(kickCd<=0&&ball.age>.5&&((bpd<1.6&&bsp<6&&ball.pos.y<P.pos.y+1.6)||bpd>42||ball.hitBack>0&&(ball.hitBack-=dt)<=0)){ball.hitBack=0;hideBall();sfx.touch();}}else ball.age=0;
  const pd=Math.hypot(ball.pos.x-P.pos.x,ball.pos.z-P.pos.z);ballGhost.visible=false;ballGhost.position.copy(ball.pos);ballRing.position.set(ball.pos.x,Math.max(0,gh)+.04,ball.pos.z);ballRing.material.opacity=P.hasBall?.3:.75;

  a.pivot.position.set(a.pos.x,J.py+a.hop,a.pos.z);
  a.pivot.rotation.set(J.px,a.yaw,0);a.hop*=Math.max(0,1-dt*8);

  a.blinkT-=dt;if(a.blinkT<=0){a.blink=.14;a.blinkT=1.8+Math.random()*3.6;}a.blink-=dt;
  if(a.speaking){a.mouthT-=dt;if(a.mouthT<=0){a.mouth=a.mouth?0:1;a.mouthT=.07+Math.random()*.09;}}else a.mouth=0;

  a.phone.visible=a.pose==='phone';}

const WX={ox:0,oz:0,fx:0,fz:1,rx:1,rz:0};
function wl(lx,lz){return[WX.ox+lx*WX.rx+lz*WX.fx,WX.oz+lx*WX.rz+lz*WX.fz];}
function wgh(x,z){const g=groundH(x,z);return g<0?g:g;}
function csAnchor(conf){let ox=P.car?P.car.x:P.pos.x,oz=P.car?P.car.z:P.pos.z,fixed=null;
  if(conf.anchor==='penalty'){const o=OR[conf.orlik||'arena'],G=orlikGoal(o);ox=G.x+G.nx*13;oz=G.z+G.nz*13;fixed=[G.nx,G.nz];}
  else if(conf.anchor==='river'){const west=Math.abs(ox-RX0)<Math.abs(ox-RX1);ox=west?RX0-1.8:RX1+1.8;const s=west?1:-1;fixed=[0,1];WX.flip=s;}
  if(P.car&&!fixed){let best=null;for(let a=0;a<8;a++){const an=a/8*TAU,x=ox+Math.sin(an)*3,z=oz+Math.cos(an)*3;if(!insideBuilding(x,z,.8)&&groundH(x,z)>=0){best=[x,z];break;}}if(best){ox=best[0];oz=best[1];}}
  if(!fixed)for(const k in OR){const o=OR[k],q=o.pitch;if(q&&ox>q.x0-1&&ox<q.x1+1&&oz>q.z0-5&&oz<q.z1+5){ox=clamp(ox,q.x0+6,q.x1-6);oz=clamp(oz,q.z0+9,q.z1-9);break;}}
  WX.ox=ox;WX.oz=oz;
  const test=(fx,fz)=>{WX.fx=fx;WX.fz=fz;WX.rx=-fz;WX.rz=fx;let sc=0;const pts=[[0,0,3],...WSET.S.map(p=>[p[0],p[1],3]),...WSET.E.map(p=>[p[0],p[1],2]),[-2.4,6.2,2],[-1.6,5,2],[1.2,3.4,1.5],[2.6,2.4,1],[-1,2,1]];

function shotGroup(push){const c=new V3();let n=0,minX=1e9,maxX=-1e9;for(const a of CS.list){const h=headPos(a,new V3());c.add(h);n++;minX=Math.min(minX,h.x);maxX=Math.max(maxX,h.x);}c.multiplyScalar(1/n);const spread=Math.max(1.6,maxX-minX);const dir=new V3(CS.shotN%2?.35:-.25,0,1).normalize();const p=c.clone().addScaledVector(dir,2.2+spread*1.15);p.y=c.y+.25;const t=c.clone();t.y-=.35;setShot(p,t,p.clone().lerp(t,push?.15:.06),t,38,36,9);}
function shotProp(a){a.pivot.updateMatrixWorld(true);const hp=a.h.elbowR.localToWorld(new V3(0,-.32,.05));const f=new V3(Math.sin(a.yaw),0,Math.cos(a.yaw)),r=new V3(f.z,0,-f.x);const p=hp.clone().addScaledVector(f,1.05).addScaledVector(r,.35);p.y=hp.y+.18;setShot(p,hp,p.clone().lerp(hp,.25),hp,24,22,4);}
function runShot(sp){const a=sp.w&&CS.actors[sp.w];if(sp.t==='plaque'){plaqueBuild();if(PLQ){const t0=new V3(PLQ.x,PLQ.y,PLQ.z),p0=new V3(PLQ.x+.6,PLQ.y+.3,PLQ.z-5.2),p1=new V3(PLQ.x+.2,PLQ.y+.15,PLQ.z-4.3);setShot(p0,t0,p1,t0,40,37,6);return;}}if(sp.t==='veh'&&CS.veh){const v=CS.veh,Y=CS.actors.Y,tx=v.x,tz=v.z;const ax=Y?Y.pos.x:tx,az=Y?Y.pos.z:tz;const dx=ax-tx,dz=az-tz,d=Math.hypot(dx,dz)||1;const p0=new V3(tx+dx/d*9+dz/d*3,2.4,tz+dz/d*9-dx/d*3),t0=new V3(tx,1.2,tz);const tg=v.g2?new V3(v.g2[0],1.2,v.g2[1]):t0;setShot(p0,t0,p0.clone().add(new V3(0,.3,0)),t0.clone().lerp(tg,.45),40,38,7);return;}if(sp.t==='group')shotGroup(true);else if(sp.t==='est')shotEst();else if(sp.t==='prop'&&a)shotProp(a);else if(a){shotMCU(a,sp.side||1);if(sp.slow&&CS.shot){CS.shot.f1=CS.shot.f0-6;CS.shot.dur=6;}}if(sp.then)CS.subs.push({at:sp.then.at,fn:()=>runShot(sp.then)});}
function present(k){return !!CS.actors[k]&&!CS.voice.has(k);}
function planShot(i,who,txt,isChoice){const thought=who==='Y'&&/^\(/.test(txt);CS.subs=[];const sp=present(who)?CS.actors[who]:null;
  if(CS.set.shotFor&&CS.set.shotFor(i,who,CS))return;

  if(!sp){if(CS.conf.phone&&CS.conf.phone.includes(who))shotMCU(CS.actors.Y);else shotVoice();return;}
  const prev=CS.prevSpk&&present(CS.prevSpk)&&CS.prevSpk!==who?CS.actors[CS.prevSpk]:null;const n=CS.shotN;

function wakeScript(a,T,dt){const s=CS.wake;if(s==null){T.px=-Math.PI/2;T.py=.96;T.tl=T.tr=0;T.kl=T.kr=.05;T.al=T.ar=0;T.alz=.16;T.arz=-.16;T.el=T.er=-.2;T.lean=0;T.twist=0;T.hyaw=.35+Math.sin(a.t*.4)*.05;T.hx=0;a.sleep=true;a.pos.set(-1,0,-1.12);a.tYaw=a.yaw=0;a.lookAt=null;a.speaking=false;a.snap=true;return;}
  const t=s,jolt=seg(t,.15,.4)-seg(t,.4,.7),u1=seg(t,.55,1.45),u2=seg(t,1.45,2.35),u3=seg(t,2.35,3.4);a.sleep=t<.3;a.lookAt=null;
  T.px=-Math.PI/2*(1-u1)+jolt*.12;T.tl=T.tr=-Math.PI/2*u1+(u3*Math.PI/2);T.kl=T.kr=1.45*seg(t,1.8,2.35)*(1-u3)+.05;T.lean=.25*u1*(1-u2)+Math.sin(u3*Math.PI)*.5;T.hyaw=(1-u1)*.35;
  T.al=lerp(0,-.35,u1)*(1-u3);T.ar=T.al;T.alz=.16;T.arz=-.16;T.el=T.er=lerp(-.2,-.9,u1)*(1-u3)-.3*u3;T.twist=0;
  const px=lerp(-1,-.42,u2)+u3*.62,py=.96-.04*u2+.06*u3,pz=-1.12+u2*.12+u3*.25;T.py=py;a.pos.set(px,0,pz);a.tYaw=a.yaw=u2*Math.PI/2*.92+seg(t,3.4,4.2)*(.55-Math.PI/2*.92);
  if(t>3.4){a.scr=null;a.tPos=a.pos.clone();a.pose='idle';a.lookAt=null;}a.snap=t<.02;}

let UWP=null;// cel ustawiony ręcznie na mapie
function setUWP(x,z,silent){UWP=x==null?null:{x,z};GPS.key='';if(!silent){sfx.blip&&sfx.blip();feed(UWP?'📍 Cel GPS ustawiony – fioletowa linia prowadzi po ulicach':'📍 Cel GPS usunięty');}}
function roadSeg(x,z){// najbliższy przejezdny odcinek ulicy: [i0,k0,i1,k1,t,dist]
  let best=null,bd=1e9;
  for(let i=0;i<=N;i++)for(let k=0;k<N;k++){if(isClosed('z',i,k))continue;const t=clamp((z-ZL[k])/(ZL[k+1]-ZL[k]),0,1),pz=lerp(ZL[k],ZL[k+1],t),d=Math.hypot(x-XL[i],z-pz);if(d<bd){bd=d;best=[i,k,i,k+1,t,d];}}
  for(let k=0;k<=N;k++)for(let i=0;i<N;i++){if(isClosed('x',k,i))continue;const t=clamp((x-XL[i])/(XL[i+1]-XL[i]),0,1),px=lerp(XL[i],XL[i+1],t),d=Math.hypot(x-px,z-ZL[k]);if(d<bd){bd=d;best=[i,k,i+1,k,t,d];}}
  return best;}
// trasa środkiem ulic (węzły skrzyżowań), potem przesunięta na PRAWY pas (ruch prawostronny)
function gpsCenter(ax,az,bx,bz){const A=roadSeg(ax,az),B=roadSeg(bx,bz);if(!A||!B)return null;
  const key=(i,k)=>i*(N+1)+k;const pa={x:lerp(XL[A[0]],XL[A[2]],A[4]),z:lerp(ZL[A[1]],ZL[A[3]],A[4])},pb={x:lerp(XL[B[0]],XL[B[2]],B[4]),z:lerp(ZL[B[1]],ZL[B[3]],B[4])};
  const sameSeg=A[0]===B[0]&&A[1]===B[1]&&A[2]===B[2]&&A[3]===B[3];if(sameSeg)return [pa,pb];
  const dist=new Map(),prev=new Map(),open=[];const segLen=s=>Math.hypot(XL[s[2]]-XL[s[0]],ZL[s[3]]-ZL[s[1]]);
  const LA=segLen(A);open.push([A[4]*LA,A[0],A[1]],[(1-A[4])*LA,A[2],A[3]]);dist.set(key(A[0],A[1]),A[4]*LA);dist.set(key(A[2],A[3]),(1-A[4])*LA);
  const LB=segLen(B),tail={[key(B[0],B[1])]:B[4]*LB,[key(B[2],B[3])]:(1-B[4])*LB};let bestEnd=null,bestTot=1e9;
  while(open.length){open.sort((u,v)=>u[0]-v[0]);const [d,i,k]=open.shift();const kk=key(i,k);if(d>(dist.get(kk)??1e9)+1e-6)continue;if(d>=bestTot)break;
    if(tail[kk]!=null&&d+tail[kk]<bestTot){bestTot=d+tail[kk];bestEnd=kk;}
    const nb=[];if(i<N&&!isClosed('x',k,i))nb.push([i+1,k,XL[i+1]-XL[i]]);if(i>0&&!isClosed('x',k,i-1))nb.push([i-1,k,XL[i]-XL[i-1]]);if(k<N&&!isClosed('z',i,k))nb.push([i,k+1,ZL[k+1]-ZL[k]]);if(k>0&&!isClosed('z',i,k-1))nb.push([i,k-1,ZL[k]-ZL[k-1]]);
    for(const [ni,nk,w] of nb){const nd=d+w,q=key(ni,nk);if(nd<(dist.get(q)??1e9)){dist.set(q,nd);prev.set(q,kk);open.push([nd,ni,nk]);}}}
  if(bestEnd==null)return null;const nodes=[];let c=bestEnd;while(c!==undefined){nodes.unshift(c);c=prev.get(c);}
  const out=[pa];for(const q of nodes){const i=Math.floor(q/(N+1)),k=q%(N+1);out.push({x:XL[i],z:ZL[k],rondo:i===RONDO.i&&k===RONDO.k});}out.push(pb);
  const dd=[];for(const q of out){const l=dd[dd.length-1];if(!l||Math.hypot(q.x-l.x,q.z-l.z)>.5)dd.push(q);else if(q.rondo)l.rondo=true;}return dd;}
const LANE=3.6;
function gpsLane(c){// przesunięcie na prawy pas; rondo objeżdżane tak, że wyspa jest po lewej
  const n=c.length,out=[];const nrm=(x,z)=>{const l=Math.hypot(x,z)||1;return [x/l,z/l];};
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const p=c[i];
    if(p.rondo&&i>0&&i<n-1){const di=nrm(p.x-c[i-1].x,p.z-c[i-1].z),dout=nrm(c[i+1].x-p.x,c[i+1].z-p.z),ri=[-di[1],di[0]],ro=[-dout[1],dout[0]];const R0=RONDO.R-2.4;
      const e=nrm(-di[0]+ri[0]*.75,-di[1]+ri[1]*.75),x_=nrm(dout[0]+ro[0]*.75,dout[1]+ro[1]*.75);const ae=Math.atan2(e[1],e[0]);let da=Math.atan2(x_[1],x_[0])-ae;while(da>-.05)da-=TAU;if(da<-TAU+.05)da+=TAU;
      const m=Math.max(4,Math.ceil(-da/.25));for(let q=0;q<=m;q++){const an=ae+da*q/m;out.push({x:p.x+Math.cos(an)*R0,z:p.z+Math.sin(an)*R0});}continue;}
    let r=[0,0];if(i>0){const d=nrm(p.x-c[i-1].x,p.z-c[i-1].z);r[0]+=-d[1];r[1]+=d[0];}if(i<n-1){const d=nrm(c[i+1].x-p.x,c[i+1].z-p.z);r[0]+=-d[1];r[1]+=d[0];}
    let rl=Math.hypot(r[0],r[1]);if(rl<.2){const d=nrm(i>0?p.x-c[i-1].x:c[i+1].x-p.x,i>0?p.z-c[i-1].z:c[i+1].z-p.z);r=[-d[1],d[0]];rl=1;}r=[r[0]/rl,r[1]/rl];
    let dot=1;if(i>0){const d=nrm(p.x-c[i-1].x,p.z-c[i-1].z);dot=Math.max(.5,r[0]*-d[1]+r[1]*d[0]);}const k=LANE/dot;out.push({x:p.x+r[0]*k,z:p.z+r[1]*k});}
  return out;}
function gpsPath(ax,az,bx,bz){const c=gpsCenter(ax,az,bx,bz);if(!c)return [{x:bx,z:bz}];const l=gpsLane(c);l.push({x:bx,z:bz});return l;}
const GPS={pts:null,route:null,cum:null,idx:0,key:'',auto:false,chk:0};
// linia na jezdni: jedna ciągła wstęga (bez nakładania), strzałki w kierunku jazdy
const gpsLineTex=ctex(64,128,(x)=>{x.clearRect(0,0,64,128);x.fillStyle='rgba(190,95,255,.6)';x.fillRect(4,0,56,128);x.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.95)';x.beginPath();x.moveTo(12,74);x.lineTo(32,44);x.lineTo(52,74);x.lineTo(52,90);x.lineTo(32,60);x.lineTo(12,90);x.closePath();x.fill();},false);gpsLineTex.wrapS=gpsLineTex.wrapT=THREE.RepeatWrapping;
const gpsLineMat=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map:gpsLineTex,color:hdr('#d890ff',1.4),transparent:true,depthWrite:false,polygonOffset:true,polygonOffsetFactor:-4,polygonOffsetUnits:-4,fog:false});
const GMAX=600,gpsPosA=new Float32Array(GMAX*2*3),gpsUvA=new Float32Array(GMAX*2*2),gpsIdxA=new Uint16Array((GMAX-1)*6);for(let i=0;i<GMAX-1;i++){const n=i*2;gpsIdxA.set([n,n+2,n+1,n+1,n+2,n+3],i*6);}
const gpsGeo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();gpsGeo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.BufferAttribute(gpsPosA,3));gpsGeo.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.BufferAttribute(gpsUvA,2));gpsGeo.setIndex(new THREE.BufferAttribute(gpsIdxA,1));gpsGeo.setDrawRange(0,0);
const gpsLine=new THREE.Mesh(gpsGeo,gpsLineMat);gpsLine.frustumCulled=false;gpsLine.renderOrder=3;gpsLine.visible=false;scene.add(gpsLine);
function gpsSetRoute(r){GPS.route=r;GPS.idx=0;GPS.cum=[0];for(let i=1;i<r.length;i++)GPS.cum.push(GPS.cum[i-1]+Math.hypot(r[i].x-r[i-1].x,r[i].z-r[i-1].z));}
function gpsProject(px,pz){const r=GPS.route;let best=1e9,bi=GPS.idx,bt=0;const i0=Math.max(0,GPS.idx-1),i1=Math.min(r.length-2,GPS.idx+8);
  for(let i=i0;i<=i1;i++){const a=r[i],b=r[i+1],dx=b.x-a.x,dz=b.z-a.z,L2=dx*dx+dz*dz||1;const t=clamp(((px-a.x)*dx+(pz-a.z)*dz)/L2,0,1);const d=Math.hypot(a.x+dx*t-px,a.z+dz*t-pz);if(d<best-.01){best=d;bi=i;bt=t;}}
  GPS.idx=bi;return {i:bi,t:bt,d:best};}
function gpsBuildLine(fromI,fromT){const r=GPS.route,W=1.3;let n=0;const pts=[];const a=r[fromI],b=r[fromI+1]||a;pts.push({x:lerp(a.x,b.x,fromT),z:lerp(a.z,b.z,fromT),u:lerp(GPS.cum[fromI],GPS.cum[fromI+1]||GPS.cum[fromI],fromT)});
  for(let i=fromI+1;i<r.length&&pts.length<GMAX;i++){pts.push({x:r[i].x,z:r[i].z,u:GPS.cum[i]});if(GPS.cum[i]-pts[0].u>380)break;}
  if(pts.length<2){gpsGeo.setDrawRange(0,0);return pts;}
  for(let i=0;i<pts.length;i++){const p=pts[i],q0=pts[Math.max(0,i-1)],q1=pts[Math.min(pts.length-1,i+1)];let dx=q1.x-q0.x,dz=q1.z-q0.z;const l=Math.hypot(dx,dz)||1;dx/=l;dz/=l;let rx=-dz,rz=dx,k=1;
    if(i>0&&i<pts.length-1){const ax=p.x-q0.x,az=p.z-q0.z,al=Math.hypot(ax,az)||1;k=1/Math.max(.55,(rx*-az+rz*ax)/al);}
    const y=Math.max(0,groundH(p.x,p.z))+.08;gpsPosA.set([p.x+rx*W/2*k,y,p.z+rz*W/2*k,p.x-rx*W/2*k,y,p.z-rz*W/2*k],i*6);gpsUvA.set([0,p.u/2.4,1,p.u/2.4],i*4);n++;}
  gpsGeo.attributes.position.needsUpdate=true;gpsGeo.attributes.uv.needsUpdate=true;gpsGeo.setDrawRange(0,(n-1)*6);return pts;}
function gpsTarget(){const s=M&&M.s;if(s&&!dlgOn&&s.wp&&!(s.ph==='pre'||s.ph==='count')){const w=s.wp();if(w&&(P.car||s.drive))return {x:w.x,z:w.z,auto:true};}
  if(UWP)return {x:UWP.x,z:UWP.z,auto:false};return null;}
function gpsUpdate(dt){gpsLineTex.offset.y-=dt*1.2;const tgt=state==='play'?gpsTarget():null;
  if(UWP&&Math.hypot(UWP.x-P.pos.x,UWP.z-P.pos.z)<14){setUWP(null,null,true);feed('📍 Jesteś na miejscu');}
  if(!tgt){GPS.pts=null;GPS.route=null;gpsLine.visible=false;return;}
  const px=P.car?P.car.x:P.pos.x,pz=P.car?P.car.z:P.pos.z;const k=Math.round(tgt.x/3)+','+Math.round(tgt.z/3);
  let pr=GPS.route&&GPS.key===k?gpsProject(px,pz):null;GPS.chk-=dt;
  if(!pr||pr.d>15||(GPS.chk<=0&&pr.d>9)){GPS.key=k;GPS.chk=1.5;gpsSetRoute(gpsPath(px,pz,tgt.x,tgt.z));pr=gpsProject(px,pz);}
  GPS.pts=gpsBuildLine(pr.i,pr.t);gpsLine.visible=GPS.pts.length>1;GPS.auto=tgt.auto;}

function nextStep(){if(!M)return;if(M.s&&M.s.end)M.s.end();M.i++;if(M.i>=M.steps.length)return winMission();
  const st=M.steps[M.i],s=ST[st[0]](st[1]||{});M.s=s;if(CPT.includes(st[0]))M.cp=M.i;if(s.time!=null)s.tl=s.time;setTimer(s.time!=null);if(s.init){stepInit=true;try{s.init();}finally{stepInit=false;}}showObj();}
function updateMission(dt){
  if(retry){retry.t-=dt;if(retry.t<=0){if(retry.def.night&&!M)setNight(0);retry=null;}else if(!M&&!dlgOn)prompt('<kbd>R</kbd> '+(retry.cp!=null?'Powtórz od punktu kontrolnego':'Powtórz misję')+': '+retry.def.t);}
  if(!M||!M.s||dlgOn)return;const s=M.s;
  if(s.tl!=null){s.tl-=dt;const t=Math.max(0,s.tl);setH('timer',Math.floor(t/60)+':'+String(Math.floor(t%60)).padStart(2,'0'));$('timer').classList.toggle('low',t<10);if(s.tl<=0)return failMission(s.timeFail||'Skończył się czas');}
  const r=s.upd?s.upd(dt):null;if(r==='ok')nextStep();else if(r)failMission(r);}
function cleanupWorld(now){lockBall=null;for(const k in givers)givers[k].hidden=false;if(P.costume)setCostume(false);duelEnd();matchEnd();hideGoal(bigGoal);bigBall.active=false;bigBall.mesh.visible=bigBall.shadow.visible=false;clearRings();clearTargets();setTimer(false);$('score').classList.add('hide');camLock=null;noCops=false;
  if(now){hideGoal(goal);rivals.forEach(r=>{if(!r.dead){r.dead=true;r.t=2.5;}});}else setTimeout(()=>{if(!M)hideGoal(goal);},1600);
  if(M&&M.car){M.car.keep=false;M.car.noExit=false;if(M.car!==P.car)M.car.tmp=25;}}
function winMission(){const d=M.def,story=M.story;cleanupWorld(false);M=null;rivals.forEach(r=>{if(!r.dead){r.dead=true;r.t=2;}});
  const pay=d.pay||0,rs=story?8:3;addCash(pay);addResp(rs);addSup(30);if(story){mi++;stats.missions++;}else{jobsDone++;stats.jobs++;}if(d.after)d.after();
  const cardDur=2.5+(d.gain||[]).length*.25;setTimeout(()=>{card(story?'MISJA ZALICZONA':(d.capture?'BOISKO PRZEJĘTE':'ZLECENIE WYKONANE'),d.t,pay,rs,d.gain||[],cardDur,()=>{if(d.out)whenFree(()=>say(d.out,()=>{if(d.night)setNight(0);refreshMks();},{def:d,phase:'out'}));else whenFree(()=>{if(d.night)setNight(0);refreshMks();});});sfx.passed();},300);
  objective('');save();
  }
function whenFree(fn){const go=()=>{if(state==='play'&&!dlgOn&&!M)fn();else if(state==='menu')return;else setTimeout(go,400);};go();}
function failMission(reason){if(!M)return;if(M.s&&M.s.end)M.s.end();retry={def:M.def,story:M.story,t:20,cp:M.cp,start:M.start};const mc=(M.cars||[]).slice();if(M.car&&!mc.includes(M.car))mc.push(M.car);if(M.s&&M.s.c&&!mc.includes(M.s.c))mc.push(M.s.c);cleanupWorld(true);M=null;if(!retry.def.night)setNight(0);for(const c of mc){if(!c)continue;if(P.car===c)exitCar(true);c.keep=false;c.tmp=-1;removeCar(c);}big('MISJA NIEUDANA',reason||'','#ff5050',2.6);sfx.fail();objective('');setTimeout(refreshMks,1500);}

function placeRings(n,cx,cz,rad){clearRings();let placed=0;
  for(let t=0;t<800&&placed<n;t++){const axisZ=Math.random()<.5,i=randi(0,N);let x,z;if(axisZ){x=XL[i];z=cz+rand(-rad,rad);}else{z=ZL[i];x=cx+rand(-rad,rad);}
    const along=axisZ?z:x;if(Math.abs(along-nearL(axisZ?ZL:XL,along))<ROAD/2+4)continue;if(x>RX0-10&&x<RX1+10)continue;
    const d=Math.hypot(x-cx,z-cz);if(d<12||d>rad+10||x<BMIN+5||x>BMAX-5||z<BMIN+5||z>BMAX-5)continue;
    if(rings.some(r=>r.on&&Math.hypot(r.m.position.x-x,r.m.position.z-z)<14))continue;
    const r=rings[placed++];if(!r)break;const y=rand(2.6,5);r.on=true;r.nx=axisZ?0:1;r.nz=axisZ?1:0;r.prev=null;
    r.m.position.set(x,y,z);r.m.rotation.y=axisZ?0:Math.PI/2;r.m.visible=true;r.posts.position.set(x,y/2,z);r.posts.rotation.y=r.m.rotation.y;r.posts.scale.set(1,y,1);r.posts.visible=true;r.glow.position.set(x,.05,z);r.glow.visible=true;}}
function updateRings(dt){if(ball.hidden)return;for(const r of rings){if(!r.on)continue;r.m.rotation.z+=dt*.8;const p=r.m.position;const rx=ball.pos.x-p.x,ry=ball.pos.y-p.y,rz=ball.pos.z-p.z;const f=rx*r.nx+rz*r.nz;
  if(r.prev!==null&&Math.sign(f)!==Math.sign(r.prev)&&r.prev!==0){const lx=rx-f*r.nx,lz=rz-f*r.nz;if(Math.hypot(lx,ry,lz)<1.45){r.on=false;r.m.visible=r.posts.visible=r.glow.visible=false;burst(p.x,p.y,p.z,60,9,['#ffcc33','#ff3d9a','#ffffff']);sfx.ring();shake=.3;hitStop=.06;floatText('OBRĘCZ!',p.x,p.y+2,p.z,'#ffcc33',28);addResp(1);addSup(10);ev('Ring');}}
  r.prev=f;}}

  burst(G.x-G.nx*G.D*.5,G.y+G.H*.6,G.z-G.nz*G.D*.5,140,12);sfx.goal();slowmo=.8;shake=.8;hitStop=.08;P.celebrate=1.6;
  if(bigText)big(dist>=28?'GOLAZO!':dist>=18?'PIĘKNY GOL!':'GOOOL!',G!==bigGoal&&dist>3?'z '+dist.toFixed(1)+' m':'','#ffcc33',1.8);}

  if(!ball.hidden)for(const G of[goal,goalB])if(cross(G,ball,'prev')){const dist=lastKick?Math.hypot(lastKick.x-G.x,lastKick.z-G.z):0;if(mt.on)matchGoal(G);else ev('Goal',G,dist);}
  if(bigBall.active&&cross(bigGoal,bigBall,'prevB'))ev('BigGoal');}

      placeBotAnim(b,dt);
    }
  }
